dual_scenarios.zh: 如对工作负担有任何顾虑，请通过指定渠道向主管反映。
dual_scenarios.en: Express any concerns about your workload to your supervisor through the designated channels.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kalau dah lama pendam, luahkan je kat aku.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Jika sudah lama memendam perasaan itu, luahkanlah kepada saya.
dual_scenarios.zh: 如果憋了很久，就跟我说吧。
dual_scenarios.en: If you've been bottling it up for a while, just tell me.
spoken_features: dah 相当于 sudah。
je 相当于 sahaja，在此使建议显得轻松。
kat 在此相当于 kepada。
aku 适用于亲近朋友之间。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku dah lama pendam benda ni, tapi tak tahu nak mula macam mana.
messages.ms_standard: Saya sudah lama memendam perkara ini, tetapi tidak tahu bagaimana hendak memulakan cerita.
messages.zh: 这事我憋了很久，可是不知道怎么开口。
messages.en: I've been keeping this to myself for ages, but I don't know where to start.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Luahkan je kat aku. Aku dengar, jangan risau.
messages.ms_standard: Luahkanlah kepada saya. Saya akan mendengar, jadi jangan bimbang.
messages.zh: 跟我说吧。我听着，别担心。
messages.en: Just tell me. I'm listening, so don't worry.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: Luahkan 可作为直接建议；对不熟悉的人可说 Jika anda selesa, luahkanlah perasaan anda，表示“如果你愿意，可以说说你的感受”。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于朋友倾诉、辅导和表达意见。邀请对方倾诉时应尊重其拒绝和隐私；在公开工作群中使用，可能使对方感到被要求披露私人情绪。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: Luahkan 可作为直接建议；对不熟悉的人可说 Jika anda selesa, luahkanlah perasaan anda，表示“如果你愿意，可以说说你的感受”。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于朋友倾诉、辅导和表达意见。邀请对方倾诉时应尊重其拒绝和隐私；在公开工作群中使用，可能使对方感到被要求披露私人情绪。

etymology.historical_story: Luahkan combines luah with the productive Malay suffix -kan. The dictionary records both physical expulsion from the mouth and the expression of feelings or wishes. This pairing gives learners a vivid metaphor: words release what the heart has held inside. It explains the senses without establishing their historical order. [Source: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=luah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: luah 是“向外吐”，加 -kan 就把内容释放出来：luahkan isi hati，把心里的话说出来。

morphology.pattern_note: 独立词根；字母 c 读 /tʃ/。派生 melicinkan 时，meN- 在 l 前实现为 me-，保留 l。

word_family.gloss: 润滑剂；使表面光滑的材料

senses.zh_definition: 滑的；因水、油或黏液等而容易使人或物打滑的。
senses.en_definition: Slippery, especially through moisture, oil, or slime.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak kesat dan mudah menyebabkan sesuatu tergelincir.
senses.nuances: 强调摩擦力小，未必表示表面外观平整；常见于地面及道路警示。

senses.zh_definition: 光滑平整的；表面细致而没有粗糙或凹凸感的。
senses.en_definition: Smooth and even in surface texture.
senses.ms_definition: Rata dan halus permukaannya, tidak menggerutu.
senses.nuances: 描述触感或表面质地，不必含有容易滑倒的意思。

senses.zh_definition: 光秃的；没有毛发或其他覆盖生长物的。
senses.en_definition: Bare or hairless.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak ditumbuhi rambut, bulu atau tumbuhan.
senses.nuances: 用于头部可表示秃顶或剃光；不是所有光滑物体都属于此义。

senses.zh_definition: 一点不剩的；钱财耗尽、食物吃光等。
senses.en_definition: Completely used up, consumed, or gone.
senses.ms_definition: Habis seluruhnya tanpa meninggalkan baki.
senses.nuances: 比喻义；口语里常用来形容菜肴被吃得精光。

senses.zh_definition: 狡猾的；善于欺骗、耍手段或歪曲话语的。
senses.en_definition: Sly or crafty in deceiving others.
senses.ms_definition: Cekap memperdaya orang atau memutarbelitkan kata-kata.
senses.nuances: 通常带贬义；不能直接当作赞美聪明或办事灵活的词。

senses.zh_definition: 难以捉住的；善于逃脱追捕或摆脱控制的。
senses.en_definition: Elusive and adept at escaping capture.
senses.ms_definition: Cekap meloloskan diri sehingga sukar ditangkap.
senses.nuances: 侧重逃脱能力，与上一义的欺骗手段有所区别。

collocations.en: a criminal skilled at evading capture

senses.zh_definition: 顺畅的；工作、运作或行程没有受到阻碍的。
senses.en_definition: Smooth and free from interruption.
senses.ms_definition: Lancar tanpa gangguan atau halangan.
senses.nuances: 词典收录此义，但现代公文描述活动或流程时，用 lancar 通常更明确。

senses.zh_definition: 植物俗名 kayu licin 的组成部分，指九节属的某些灌木。
senses.en_definition: In kayu licin, a vernacular name for shrubs of the genus Psychotria.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam nama kayu licin, sejenis pokok renek daripada genus Psychotria.
senses.nuances: 罕见植物名称，词典另列为 licin II；不能把一般形容词义套用为植物分类。以下为名称及其扩展短语，并非高频日常搭配。[DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=licin)

collocations.zh: 称为 kayu licin 的灌木
collocations.en: the shrub known as kayu licin

collocations.zh: 一株 kayu licin 灌木

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 提醒他人地滑可用 Hati-hati, lantai licin。说某人 licin 容易被理解为指责其狡诈；谈论光头或皮肤也应顾及对方感受。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 用于地面、材料表面和食物吃光都很自然。正式汇报流程顺利时优先用 lancar；不要把形容骗子的 licin 用作对上司或陌生人的随意赞美。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 提醒他人地滑可用 Hati-hati, lantai licin。说某人 licin 容易被理解为指责其狡诈；谈论光头或皮肤也应顾及对方感受。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 用于地面、材料表面和食物吃光都很自然。正式汇报流程顺利时优先用 lancar；不要把形容骗子的 licin 用作对上司或陌生人的随意赞美。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve a striking network of meanings around licin: slippery surfaces, smooth skin, emptied possessions, deception, escape, and uninterrupted progress. Read together, these senses suggest a useful image of things offering little resistance or leaving nothing behind. This is a semantic interpretation, rather than a documented chronology of the word's origin. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=licin)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 li-cin /li-tʃin/ 的两拍配上脚底一滑的动作：表面滑、骗子滑头、饭菜吃得精光。

morphology.pattern_note: 作为人名整词使用；词尾 -y 不属于此处的马来语后缀。IPA 为英语人名读法，不是已认证的马来语标准读法。

senses.zh_definition: 莱蒂：英语女性人名，可作 Lettice 的昵称。
senses.en_definition: Letty, a feminine English given name or diminutive of Lettice.
senses.ms_definition: Letty ialah nama perempuan dalam bahasa Inggeris yang juga digunakan sebagai nama timangan bagi Lettice.
senses.nuances: 属专有名词，通常写作 Letty。不能仅凭名字确定某个人物、国籍或完整姓名。以下组合展示人名在马来语中的句法用法，不是固定搭配；马来语释义为编写说明，并非 DBP 原文。人名及英语读音见 [Behind the Name: Letty](https://www.behindthename.com/name/letty)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 不要擅自将 Letty 扩写为 Lettice 或 Letitia，也不要仅凭名字推断宗教、族群或身份。

etymology.historical_story: Letty is recorded as a familiar form of Lettice. The related name Letitia comes from Latin laetitia, meaning joy or gladness. This history explains an association with happiness, but a person's name is not ordinarily translated by its ancestral meaning. In Malay conversation, Letty functions as a name identifying its bearer. [Letty](https://www.behindthename.com/name/letty), [Letitia](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Letitia).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 英语读音近“莱蒂”；想象朋友介绍“这是莱蒂”。它用来叫人，不用来表达“快乐”。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中作为完整词根处理，不拆成 lu-、maya 或 -an；字母 y 表示 /j/。下列词族形式是附加语法成分的形式，不是新的派生词根。

word_family.gloss: 算不错啦；确实相当可观
真丰厚啊；如感叹奖金丰厚

senses.zh_definition: 尚可的、够用的；指收入、收成或所得达到令人满意的程度，但未必很多。
senses.en_definition: Adequate or reasonably good in amount, especially of income, yield or proceeds.
senses.ms_definition: Cukup, agak banyak atau sederhana, terutama tentang pendapatan, hasil dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 语义重点可以是“还不错、足够”，不保证数额很大。需结合 jumlahnya tidak banyak tetapi lumayan 等上下文判断，不能一律译为“暴利”。

senses.zh_definition: 丰厚的、可观的；指收入、利润、奖金或酬劳数额很大。
senses.en_definition: Substantial, generous or lucrative, especially of earnings, profits or rewards.
senses.ms_definition: Banyak sekali atau mewah, terutama tentang wang, hadiah, pendapatan atau ganjaran.
senses.nuances: 在 ganjaran lumayan、keuntungan lumayan 等搭配中，通常强调金额丰厚。用于工作机会时可译“报酬优厚”，用于利润时可译“利润可观”；词义范围及爪哇语来源参见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=lumayan+1)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Syarikat itu menawarkan ganjaran yang lumayan kepada pekerja yang mencapai sasaran jualan tahunan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该公司向达到年度销售目标的员工提供丰厚奖励。
dual_scenarios.en: The company offers generous rewards to employees who meet their annual sales targets.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Upah kerja hujung minggu ni lumayan juga, boleh tambah simpanan.

dual_scenarios.zh: 这周末这份活的报酬还挺不错，能多存点钱。
dual_scenarios.en: The pay for this weekend's work is pretty decent. I can add it to my savings.
spoken_features: ni 对应 ini。
省略部分介词和主语，使聊天更简洁。
juga 在此加强“还挺不错”的评价。

messages.en: Nice! Are you saving it all or spending just a little?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 评价自己的收入时，lumayan 可表达较含蓄的满意。询问不熟悉者的具体薪水可能显得冒昧；可改问待遇是否符合期望。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合描述收入、收益、奖金和报酬。感谢别人赠礼时，仅说 lumayan 可能显得只顾估价或评价保留，宜直接表达感谢。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 评价自己的收入时，lumayan 可表达较含蓄的满意。询问不熟悉者的具体薪水可能显得冒昧；可改问待遇是否符合期望。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合描述收入、收益、奖金和报酬。感谢别人赠礼时，仅说 lumayan 可能显得只顾估价或评价保留，宜直接表达感谢。

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies lumayan as a word of Javanese origin. Its Malay meanings cover both an adequate amount and a very generous one, so context determines the strength of the praise. A modest harvest may be lumayan because it is satisfactory, while a prize may be lumayan because it is substantial. See [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=lumayan+1).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lu-ma-yan 联想成“领了钱，露满意颜”：报酬 lumayan，可能是“还不错”，也可能“很丰厚”，看语境。

morphology.pattern_note: 单音节独立词根。研磨义主要构成复合词，不宜凭空拆分词缀；焊接义另有 mengelas 等派生形式，须与研磨义分开理解。

senses.zh_definition: 研磨材料或器具的复合词构词成分，见于磨刀石、砂纸、砂轮等名称。
senses.en_definition: An element in compounds naming abrasive materials or grinding tools.
senses.ms_definition: Unsur dalam nama bahan atau alat pengasah dan penggosok, seperti batu las, kertas las dan roda las.
senses.nuances: 对应输入资料的 las I；主要依附完整搭配理解，不应直接当作现代口语中“打磨”的通用动词。kertas pasir 是砂纸的常用说法。[参考：DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=las)

senses.zh_definition: 通过加热熔接形成的金属接合处；焊接接头。
senses.en_definition: A weld; a joint made by joining metal through heat.
senses.ms_definition: Sambungan pada besi atau logam lain yang dihasilkan melalui pemanasan.
senses.nuances: DBP 另列为 las II，并标注 IB，即源自荷兰语；不要与 las I 的研磨义混为一谈。马来西亚一般技术表达常用 kimpalan 和 mengimpal。[参考：DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Search?k=las)

etymology.historical_story: Malay log belongs to the English record-keeping vocabulary. Its maritime background offers a memorable connection: sailors measured speed using a wooden device called a log, then recorded navigational information for later reference. Historical deck records preserve that association between measurement and written evidence. Today's maintenance books and computer logs continue the broader practice of keeping an inspectable account. [Royal Museums Greenwich](https://www.rmg.co.uk/collections/objects/rmgc-object-43180)

etymology.historical_story: Larilah combines the verb lari with the attached particle -lah. Its spelling reflects the Malay convention of writing this particle together with the preceding word. In conversation, the combination can encourage a runner or urgently tell someone to flee. In narrative prose, -lah can instead highlight an event, so the surrounding sentence determines whether a command is intended. [DBP: Malay spelling guidelines](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)

senses.nuances: 通常作为整句或话语标记使用，可带不耐烦、赌气或无奈。不是中性的礼貌许可。此处为口语用法的释义归纳；DBP 在 lantak 条下记录“随意行事”义。[DBP：lantak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=lantak) -lah 的强调语气取决于语境。[DBP：语气词说明](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2022/03/16/2777/)

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries record lantak both for forceful physical actions and for acting as one pleases. In lantaklah, the latter meaning provides a useful connection to the conversational expression, while lah adds emphasis. This is a semantic explanation rather than a proven historical sequence; the available evidence does not establish when the dismissive expression first appeared.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lantak + lah 记成一句带情绪的“随他啦！”；这里的 lah 不保证语气温柔。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries record lamar through a family of words covering marriage proposals and applications for employment. Both uses involve asking another party to accept a proposed relationship, whether personal or professional. That connection is a useful semantic comparison, but it does not establish which meaning came first. The evidence consulted does not justify assigning a particular ancient donor language. etymology.historical_story: Lenny is documented as a familiar form of Leonard in English naming practice. Such familiar forms express personal familiarity rather than a new dictionary meaning. When the name appears in a Malay conversation, it identifies a person without acquiring Malay prefixes or suffixes. Its English name history should therefore remain separate from Malay morphological analysis. [Name reference](https://www.behindthename.com/name/lenny).

etymology.historical_story: Louise is the French feminine form of Louis. Louis continues a Germanic naming tradition through Latinized forms, with older elements associated with fame and battle. These historical associations explain the name's ancestry; they are not its everyday dictionary meaning. In Malay discourse, Louise simply identifies a person bearing that name.

etymology.historical_story: The base lepas expresses being free or beyond a restriction. With -i, the verb stem lepasi directs attention to what is passed or overcome. Dictionary records also preserve senses involving settling debts and covering expenses. These meanings offer a useful semantic connection: an obstacle, obligation, or expense is something that must be dealt with.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lepas 想成脱离限制，lepasi 想成跨过眼前这一关；主动句常用 melepasi，kita lepasi 常见于被动结构。

etymology.historical_story: The cultural history of labu reaches beyond the kitchen. Malaysia's heritage department explains that labu sayong takes its name from its resemblance to a bottle gourd and from Sayong, a pottery-making locality in Perak. The name links a plant shape with a familiar household vessel, providing a concrete illustration of meaning extending through resemblance. [Department of National Heritage](https://www.heritage.gov.my/en/component/content/article/warisan-tidak-ketara-seni-halus-ukiran.html?Itemid=982&catid=17).

etymology.historical_story: Lucifer comes from Latin elements meaning light and bearing. It originally designated the morning star, linking the name to Venus before sunrise. Its later association with Satan arose through Christian interpretation of Isaiah 14:12. The astronomical origin and the religious name therefore belong to different historical contexts, rather than expressing a single timeless meaning. [Oxford: Lucifer](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/lucifer)

etymology.historical_story: Leah is a Hebrew personal name known from Genesis, where Leah is one of Jacob's wives. Its original meaning remains disputed. A Hebrew verb with the same consonants means to be weary, but that connection does not settle the name's derivation. Modern bearers use Leah as a personal name, without necessarily invoking that proposed meaning or the biblical figure. [University of Iowa: Leah](https://bam.sites.uiowa.edu/hello/leah)

senses.nuances: 此义读 [le.bam]，即 lébam，与淤青义的 [lə.bam] 不同。保留词典的属名写法，不把该地方鱼名强行对应到单一现代物种。词典鱼名义见 [DBP：lebam](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=139128&keyword=lebam)。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 淤青义适用于日常关心、事故记录及伤势描述；鱼市或菜单中的 ikan lebam 是鱼名。不要把鱼名、拟声词与身体伤痕义混为一谈。

etymology.historical_story: Lebam shows why Malay readers must sometimes hear a word before identifying its meaning. DBP separates the familiar bruised colour, a thudding sound and a marine fish name. The fish name has é rather than the schwa heard in the bruise word. Their shared spelling does not establish a shared historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 bam 联想成撞到桌角时的“砰”：撞一下，皮肤就 lebam。这个联想只是记忆法；鱼名另读 lébam。

morphology.pattern_note: 首音节的 e 读央元音 /ə/。派生词 melebuhkan 由 meN- + lebuh + -kan 构成；词根以 l 开头时，meN- 实现为 me-，保留 l。lebuh raya 是分写的复合词。

word_family.gloss: 连接城市的宽阔主要公路；常指高速公路

senses.zh_definition: 大路，宽阔的道路；也用于街道名称及道路类复合词。
senses.en_definition: A broad road or major street, also used in street names and road compounds.
senses.ms_definition: Jalan raya atau jalan yang besar.
senses.nuances: 普通交流中 jalan 更通用。lebuh raya 指宽阔的主要公路，通常连接不同城市；具体是否为收费或受控出入口道路，应看实际道路。lebuh hias 指通常设有人行道并以树木美化的城市主要道路。参见：[DBP PRPM：lebuh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=lebuh)。

collocations.zh: 主要干线公路；高速公路

senses.zh_definition: 不见了，失踪了，尤指被人偷走；霹雳方言口语。
senses.en_definition: Missing or gone, especially through theft; colloquial Perak dialect.
senses.ms_definition: Hilang atau lesap, khususnya kerana dicuri orang, dalam percakapan dialek Perak.
senses.nuances: 这是另列的 lebuh II；Pr 表示霹雳，bp 表示口语。不能将这一地方义当作全国通行的 hilang 的替代词。参见：[DBP PRPM：lebuh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=lebuh)。以下为说明性搭配。

dual_scenarios.context: 道路工程公告 / 新闻
dual_scenarios.ms: Kerja penyelenggaraan lebuh raya itu akan dilaksanakan secara berperingkat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 该高速公路的养护工程将分阶段进行。
dual_scenarios.en: Maintenance work on the expressway will be carried out in stages.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 商量行车路线
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kita ikut lebuh raya je, senang sikit.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kita menggunakan lebuh raya sahaja kerana perjalanan lebih mudah.
dual_scenarios.zh: 我们就走高速吧，比较方便。
dual_scenarios.en: Let's just take the expressway. It'll be easier.
spoken_features: ikut 在路线语境中表示走某条路。
je 对应 sahaja。
sikit 对应 sedikit，此处缓和比较语气。
dah 对应 sudah。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Nak ikut lebuh raya ke jalan biasa?
messages.ms_standard: Adakah kita hendak menggunakan lebuh raya atau jalan biasa?
messages.zh: 要走高速还是普通公路？

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 道路义语体中性，适合正式公告及日常交流。问路时使用 Maaf, boleh tunjukkan jalan ke…? 比直接发出命令自然。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 引用街道名称时保留官方拼写，包括名称中的 Lebuh。一般问路优先用 jalan；表示失踪的方言义只宜在彼此理解的地方口语中使用。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 道路义语体中性，适合正式公告及日常交流。问路时使用 Maaf, boleh tunjukkan jalan ke…? 比直接发出命令自然。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 引用街道名称时保留官方拼写，包括名称中的 Lebuh。一般问路优先用 jalan；表示失踪的方言义只宜在彼此理解的地方口语中使用。

etymology.historical_story: Lebuh carries an older road vocabulary into modern transport language. DBP records both the broad road meaning and compounds such as lebuh raya and lebuh hias, alongside melebuhkan, meaning to open a road. These forms connect the idea of a substantial thoroughfare with later road planning. The consulted entry does not establish an ultimate etymology. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=lebuh).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 le.buh 读成两步走上大路，再接 raya，记住 lebuh raya 这条宽阔干道。

morphology.pattern_note: 现代马来语中按完整借词记忆，不把 le- 误认作能产前缀；首音节 e 读 /ə/，c 读 /tʃ/。

senses.zh_definition: 引人发笑的话语、故事或笑料；笑话。
senses.en_definition: A joke, humorous story, or amusing remark.
senses.ms_definition: Percakapan, cerita atau sesuatu yang menggelikan hati; jenaka atau lawak.
senses.nuances: 词典标记 Jw，表示源自爪哇语。马来西亚日常交流更常用 lawak 或 jenaka；lelucon 较有书面或印尼语色彩。作名词，不能直接替代形容词 lucu。[DBP 词条与词性说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=lelucon)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Penceramah menyelitkan lelucon yang sesuai untuk menarik perhatian para peserta.
dual_scenarios.zh: 主讲人穿插了恰当的笑话，以吸引参与者的注意。
dual_scenarios.en: The speaker included appropriate jokes to engage the participants.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Lelucon dalam buku ni lawak juga, kan?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Lelucon dalam buku ini agak menggelikan hati, bukan?
dual_scenarios.zh: 这本书里的笑话还挺好笑的，对吧？
dual_scenarios.en: The jokes in this book are pretty funny, aren't they?
spoken_features: ni 是 ini 的口语缩略。
kan 在句末征求认同。
lelucon 在此因谈论书中内容而自然出现；一般闲聊更常说 lawak。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kau dah baca lelucon kat muka surat ni?
messages.ms_standard: Awak sudah membaca lelucon pada halaman ini?
messages.zh: 你看过这一页的笑话了吗？
messages.en: Have you read the joke on this page?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, aku ingat cerita biasa je. Rupanya lawak!
messages.ms_standard: Sudah. Saya menyangka cerita itu hanya cerita biasa. Rupa-rupanya cerita itu menggelikan hati!
messages.zh: 看了，我还以为只是普通故事呢，结果挺好笑！
messages.en: Yeah. I thought it was just an ordinary story, but it turned out to be funny!

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 在马来西亚，说笑能拉近距离，但应先判断双方关系；对长辈或初次见面的同事，避免拿对方本人当笑料。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合谈论幽默故事、文学作品和演讲中的笑料；涉及族群、宗教、身体特征或私人困境时，应避免冒犯性的玩笑。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 在马来西亚，说笑能拉近距离，但应先判断双方关系；对长辈或初次见面的同事，避免拿对方本人当笑料。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合谈论幽默故事、文学作品和演讲中的笑料；涉及族群、宗教、身体特征或私人困境时，应避免冒犯性的玩笑。

etymology.historical_story: Dewan Bahasa dan Pustaka labels lelucon as Javanese in origin. Its dictionary meaning centres on amusing speech and stories. This gives learners a small glimpse of contact between neighbouring literary traditions: Malay can retain a borrowed word for humour alongside familiar alternatives such as jenaka and lawak. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=lelucon)。
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 le-lu-con 想成讲笑话的三拍节奏：铺垫、转折、笑点；这是节奏联想，不是词源拆分。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语来源的整词，现代马来语中不拆作本族词根和词缀。输入提供的本地化读音为 /ˈlaptop/，实际可读作 [ˈlap̚.t̪op̚]。

word_family.gloss: 其笔记本电脑；接附着代词
我的笔记本电脑；接附着代词

senses.zh_definition: 笔记本电脑；将屏幕、键盘及主要运算部件集成在便携机身内的个人电脑。
senses.en_definition: A portable personal computer with an integrated screen and keyboard.
senses.ms_definition: Komputer peribadi mudah alih yang menggabungkan skrin, papan kekunci dan komponen utamanya dalam satu unit; komputer riba.
senses.nuances: laptop 常见于日常交流和科技语境；正式马来语术语为 komputer riba。词族所列 laptopnya、laptopku 是接附着代词的形式，并非另造的派生词。见 [DBP 信息与通信技术术语表](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/maklumat1.pdf)。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Semua laptop yang dibekalkan kepada kakitangan hendaklah direkodkan sebagai aset jabatan.
dual_scenarios.zh: 所有配发给员工的笔记本电脑都须登记为部门资产。
dual_scenarios.en: All laptops supplied to staff must be recorded as departmental assets.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Laptop aku dah habis bateri. Boleh pinjam pengecas kau kejap?
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Bateri komputer riba saya sudah kehabisan kuasa. Bolehkah saya meminjam pengecas awak sebentar?

dual_scenarios.en: My laptop's out of battery. Can I borrow your charger for a minute?
spoken_features: dah 对应 sudah
kejap 对应 sebentar
aku、kau 用于熟人之间
laptop 为日常常用英语形式，规范对应为 komputer riba

messages.ms_spoken: Laptop aku dah habis bateri. Boleh pinjam pengecas kau kejap?
messages.ms_standard: Bateri komputer riba saya sudah kehabisan kuasa. Bolehkah saya meminjam pengecas awak sebentar?

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 谈工作设备时 laptop 容易理解；正式文件、采购说明和面向公众的马来语文稿宜优先使用 komputer riba。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 借用他人的电脑或配件时，用 Boleh saya pinjam…? 礼貌询问。日常称 laptop 不表示设备属于某种特定品牌。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 谈工作设备时 laptop 容易理解；正式文件、采购说明和面向公众的马来语文稿宜优先使用 komputer riba。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 借用他人的电脑或配件时，用 Boleh saya pinjam…? 礼貌询问。日常称 laptop 不表示设备属于某种特定品牌。

etymology.historical_story: The English compound laptop combines lap, the resting space formed by a seated person's thighs, with top. The name evokes a computer small enough to sit there. Malay expresses the same image through komputer riba, since riba means lap. Remembering that shared physical image links the everyday English form with its formal Malay equivalent.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lap 是“大腿上的膝前空间”，top 是“上面”：放在腿上的电脑就是 laptop；马来语 komputer riba 也沿用这个画面。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根无词缀；加 meN- 时，在 l 前采用 me-，保留 l：meN- + lolos + -kan → meloloskan。

senses.zh_definition: 从原来套住或固定的位置滑脱、脱落，如戒指从手指上滑落。
senses.en_definition: To slip off or come loose from its position.
senses.ms_definition: Lepas dari tempatnya, seperti cincin dari jari atau gelang dari tangan; lucut.
senses.nuances: 表示物件脱离原来的位置，不一定已经遗失。若强调主动摘下或使其脱落，可用 meloloskan。

collocations.en: a ring slips off a finger
a bracelet slips off a wrist

senses.zh_definition: 从囚禁、围困或拦截中逃脱、脱身。
senses.en_definition: To escape from confinement, encirclement or interception.
senses.ms_definition: Lepas dari kurungan atau kepungan.
senses.nuances: 常见于逃脱或突破封锁的叙述。lolos 是不及物用法；meloloskan diri 表示使自己脱身。马来西亚标准语中，“考试及格”通常用 lulus，“晋级”通常用 layak，而不宜直接套用印尼语中 lolos 的相关用法。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Suspek berjaya lolos daripada kepungan sebelum pasukan bantuan tiba.
dual_scenarios.zh: 嫌疑人在支援队伍抵达前成功逃出了包围。
dual_scenarios.en: The suspect escaped from the encirclement before reinforcements arrived.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kucing tu lolos dari sangkar tadi, lah!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kucing itu terlepas dari sangkar tadi!
dual_scenarios.zh: 那只猫刚才从笼子里跑出来啦！
dual_scenarios.en: The cat got out of its cage just now!
spoken_features: tu 对应标准语 itu。
lah 在此加强提醒和惊讶的语气。
lolos 在此能理解，但日常马来西亚口语更常说 terlepas。

messages.speaker: Aina (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kucing tu lolos dari sangkar tadi, lah! Kau nampak tak?
messages.ms_standard: Kucing itu terlepas dari sangkar tadi! Adakah awak melihatnya?
messages.zh: 那只猫刚才从笼子里跑出来啦！你看见了吗？
messages.en: The cat got out of its cage just now! Have you seen it?

messages.speaker: Farah (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Nampak, dia kat bawah meja je. Aku nak ambil dia sekarang.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya melihatnya. Kucing itu berada di bawah meja sahaja. Saya hendak mengambilnya sekarang.
messages.zh: 看见了，就在桌子底下。我现在去抱它。
messages.en: Yes, it's just under the table. I'll go and get it now.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 词本身没有冒犯性，但用于人时常涉及逃脱、拘禁或追捕。正式报道应准确交代人物身份和事件背景。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合描述实际脱落或逃脱；不要把普通离开说成 lolos，以免带出逃避控制的意味。表达考试及格时使用 lulus。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 词本身没有冒犯性，但用于人时常涉及逃脱、拘禁或追捕。正式报道应准确交代人物身份和事件背景。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适合描述实际脱落或逃脱；不要把普通离开说成 lolos，以免带出逃避控制的意味。表达考试及格时使用 lulus。

etymology.historical_story: The supplied Kamus Dewan entry places two concrete scenes together: a ring slipping off a finger and someone escaping confinement. Their shared image is release from something that holds. This semantic connection makes a useful learning story, but it does not establish the word's historical origin or justify a speculative ancient root.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 lo-los，想象松松的戒指溜下手指，再把“溜脱”联想到逃出包围。

morphology.pattern_note: 直接接后缀 -kan，词干不发生音变；首音节 e 为 /e/。输入 Jawi 字段 ليمڤر 实为词根 lempar 的拼写，完整 lemparkan 应写作 ليمڤرکن，此处按要求保留原包字段。

senses.zh_definition: 把某物扔出、投出或抛向某处。
senses.en_definition: To throw, cast, or hurl something towards a place or person.
senses.ms_definition: Melontarkan atau membalingkan sesuatu ke arah orang atau tempat tertentu.
senses.nuances: lemparkan 可用于命令句，也可用于第一、第二人称被动结构，如 bola itu saya lemparkan。正式第三人称主动陈述一般用 melemparkan。-kan 在此构成及物动词，不表示过去时。义项参照其完整主动形式：[DBP PRPM：melemparkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=melemparkan)。

senses.zh_definition: 向某人提出指责、批评，或把愤怒等情绪发泄到某人身上。
senses.en_definition: To direct accusations, criticism, or anger at someone.
senses.ms_definition: Mengeluarkan tuduhan atau kritikan, atau meluahkan kemarahan terhadap seseorang.
senses.nuances: 比喻把言语或情绪投向对象。lemparkan tuduhan 的语气较强，往往带有攻击性；中性报告宜根据语境选用 mengemukakan dakwaan 或 menyampaikan kritikan。

senses.zh_definition: 把目光投向某处，或向某人报以微笑等表情。
senses.en_definition: To cast a glance or direct a smile towards someone.
senses.ms_definition: Menghalakan pandangan ke sesuatu arah atau memberikan senyuman kepada seseorang.
senses.nuances: 常见于描写性文字。melemparkan senyuman 表示向某人微笑，并不带有扔东西的粗鲁意味；日常口语通常直接说 senyum。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报

dual_scenarios.zh: 请按照队长的指示，将救生绳抛向受困者。
dual_scenarios.en: Please throw the rescue rope towards the casualty as instructed by the team leader.

dual_scenarios.context: WhatsApp / 日常口语交流
dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Lemparkan bola tu kat aku, aku dah sedia!
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Lemparkan bola itu kepada saya; saya sudah bersedia!

dual_scenarios.en: Throw me the ball. I'm ready!

kat 在此口语中表示接收对象，标准语用 kepada。
dah 对应 sudah；aku 用于熟人之间。
日常交流也常直接说 Lempar bola tu。

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Lemparkan bola tu kat aku, aku dah sedia!
messages.ms_standard: Lemparkan bola itu kepada saya; saya sudah bersedia!

messages.en: Okay, I'll give it a gentle throw. Make sure you catch it!

etymology.historical_story: Lemparkan is transparently formed from lempar and the Malay suffix -kan. Its physical image extends into social expression: accusations can be hurled, while a glance or smile can be directed towards someone. DBP records these extensions under melemparkan. They provide a useful semantic history within Malay, without establishing a particular external source language for lempar. [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=melemparkan)

headword.status_note: 保留请求指定的条目状态；本项描述马来西亚口语中的英语插入用法，不表示 live 已被确认为规范马来语词。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语整词插入马来语句子，无马来语词缀。直播、现场演出义读 /laɪv/；勿与英语表示生活或居住的动词 live /lɪv/ 混淆。

senses.zh_definition: 直播的；节目或内容随事件发生而即时播出，而非播放预先录制的版本。
senses.en_definition: Broadcast or transmitted as an event happens, rather than played from a prerecorded version.
senses.ms_definition: Disiarkan secara langsung ketika sesuatu peristiwa sedang berlaku, bukannya melalui rakaman terdahulu.
senses.nuances: 常见于社交媒体与口语混用。正式马来语通常用 langsung 或 secara langsung；PRPM 将传播领域的英语 live 对应为 langsung。本条马来语释义为编写性释义。[DBP 术语对应](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=langsung+1)。

senses.zh_definition: 现场演出的；表演者当场进行表演，而非仅播放录制内容。
senses.en_definition: Performed in person at the event rather than presented solely through a recording.
senses.ms_definition: Dipersembahkan sendiri oleh penghibur di tempat acara, bukan sekadar memainkan rakaman.
senses.nuances: 现场演出不必同时向网络观众直播。正式表达可用 persembahan secara langsung；应根据语境区分现场演出与即时转播。[Merriam-Webster 的 live 演出义](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/live)。

senses.zh_definition: 开直播；通过网络实时向观众播送自己的画面、声音或活动。
senses.en_definition: To broadcast oneself or an activity live over the internet.
senses.ms_definition: Menyiarkan diri atau sesuatu aktiviti secara langsung melalui Internet.
senses.nuances: 马来西亚非正式语境中，live 可直接充当谓语，例如 nak live。此为口语语码转换，不是英语 live /lɪv/ 的生活义；正式表达用 membuat siaran langsung。本条记录口语用法，不将其标为 DBP 官方动词。

etymology.historical_story: The English adjective live developed as a shortened form of alive. Its established meanings include performances delivered before an audience and broadcasts transmitted while events occur. These senses explain the connection between live entertainment and live streaming. The similarly spelled English verb meaning to reside or remain alive has a different pronunciation, /lɪv/. [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/live).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 /laɪv/ 和亮起的直播灯连起来：灯一亮，观众现在就能看到你。

senses.zh_definition: 线；尤指练习本、纸页等上面画出或印出的横线、格线。

senses.ms_definition: Garis pada buku dan sebagainya.

etymology.historical_story: A notebook's ruled page offers a useful window into this word's history. Kamus Dewan records lin with the labels IB and bp, linking it to Indonesian–Dutch vocabulary and colloquial usage. That classification preserves evidence of language contact in an ordinary object: a line on paper. It supports the broad historical connection, but does not establish an exact borrowing date or donor form. [DBP entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=lin)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lin /lin/ 与英语 line 的字形联想起来：看见练习本上的一道线，就想起 lin＝garis。这里只是助记，不把两者读音或全部义项等同。

etymology.historical_story: Pepper gives lada a place in Malaysia's trading history. Originating on India's western coast, the crop spread through maritime commerce and became established commercially in nineteenth-century Sarawak. This history concerns the plant rather than proving the word's ultimate linguistic origin. In modern Malay, lada also appears in names for chillies. [Source: Department of Statistics Malaysia](https://statistics.gov.my/portal-main/release-document-log?release_document_id=18088).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lada 的开头联想到“辣”：先记住辛香食材，再用 hitam、putih、merah 分清黑胡椒、白胡椒和红辣椒；这是记忆联想，不是词源。

etymology.historical_story: Lebuh raya combines lebuh, a road or broad street, with raya, meaning great or large. Its structure therefore offers a useful picture of a major road connecting places. Modern Malaysian usage often brings expressways to mind, but toll payment is not inherent in the dictionary meaning. Standard spelling keeps the components separate, although established official names may preserve a joined form. [Sources: PRPM definition](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=lebuh), [DBP spelling guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=lebuhraya).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lebuh＝路，raya＝大：两块拼成“大通道”，想到连接城市的干线公路；正式书写给两块之间留一个空格。

etymology.historical_story: The latih family captures several sides of learning: berlatih names practice, melatih names training someone, and latihan names the activity or exercise. In Malaysian classrooms, latih tubi makes repetition explicit. Jurulatih identifies the coach, while pelatih requires context because dictionaries record both the person receiving training and the person providing it.

etymology.historical_story: Loteng comes from Hokkien lâu-téng, written 樓頂, referring to the upper floor or upstairs. The same expression also entered Singapore Mandarin. In Malay, its meanings include both the upper part of a house and a boarded ceiling. The word preserves a small but vivid trace of contact between neighbouring language communities. [Singapore Mandarin Database](https://www.languagecouncils.sg/mandarin/ch/learning-resources/singaporean-mandarin-database/terms/upstairs-colloquially-known-as-lau-deng)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: loteng 联想福建话“楼顶”lâu-téng：先想到楼上、阁楼，再记住它还可指头顶上的木板天花板。

senses.zh_definition: 【英语及英马夹杂语境】由暴民未经合法审判或授权而将某人私刑处死，常见方式为绞死。
senses.en_definition: To kill someone through mob action without legal authority, often by hanging.
senses.ms_definition: Padanan Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan: menggantung seseorang tanpa perbicaraan. Dalam pengertian Inggeris yang lebih luas: membunuh seseorang melalui tindakan kumpulan perusuh tanpa kuasa undang-undang.
senses.nuances: 此词由 DBP《Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan》作为英语词头收录；本条 status 的 official 仅指这一收录依据，不表示它已成为标准马来语词头。搭配栏 ms 提供马来语对应表达，en 保留英语搭配。英语本义不限于绞死，也不等于一般殴打或网络批评。[DBP：lynch 的英马释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=digantung)，[Merriam-Webster：lynch](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/lynch)。

collocations.zh: 未经审判将某人私刑绞死

etymology.historical_story: The English verb lynch developed from the expression lynch law; Merriam-Webster dates its first known use to 1835. Its central idea is a crowd taking lethal punishment into its own hands without legal authority. DBP includes it in its English–Malay dictionary, which explains its appearance in the packet without establishing it as a standard Malay borrowing. [Merriam-Webster: lynch](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/lynch).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 /lɪntʃ/，整词记忆：看到 lynch，就想到“暴民越过审判直接杀人”；不是普通的责骂。

etymology.historical_story: The geographical name Lorraine developed from medieval forms associated with Lotharingia, the kingdom named after Lothair II. Historical scholarship distinguishes that larger kingdom from the southern territory later called Lorraine. The name therefore preserves a ruler's memory within a landscape, rather than containing a Malay root or affix. [Historical study](https://rgh.univ-lorraine.fr/articles/view/45/La_production_d_un_espace_debuts_lotharingiens_et_pratiques_de_la_frontiere_IXe_XIe_siecle.1.html)

etymology.historical_story: Lyra belongs to the ancient Greek constellation tradition recorded by Ptolemy. Its name represents a lyre, preserving an image of a musical instrument in the sky. Modern astronomy retains the historical name while defining the constellation as a bounded region, rather than merely a drawing made by connecting stars. [Historical identification](https://library.cfa.harvard.edu/iau-constellations); [modern definition](https://www.iau.org/IAU/Astronomy-FAQs/Constellations.aspx).

etymology.historical_story: Malay forms laluan from lalu, meaning to pass, with the noun-forming suffix -an. The result names a route or passage. Adding -nya ties that route to an understood person or thing. The dictionary also records a figurative path toward another stage, connecting physical movement with advancement without requiring a separate root.

A plausible explanation is confusion between lowercase l and uppercase I, producing ltulah from Itulah. The proposed correction contains itu and the attached emphatic particle -lah. etymology.historical_story: The deeper origin of the leisure sense is not established here. Its Malaysian social history is better documented: a 1995 research paper describes public concern about budaya lepak emerging in 1993. Contemporary friendly invitations can carry a milder meaning, so the critical institutional label and casual social use should be distinguished. [Malaysian youth research paper](https://www.iyres.gov.my/jdownloads/kertaskerja/tingkah-laku-lepak-media-dan-pengawasan-keluarga.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Laun belongs to an old Austronesian family connecting slowness with extended time. The [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/32948) reconstructs a related ancestral form and compares Malay with Iban, Sundanese and Philippine languages. Some relatives describe aged rice or things kept for a long time. Malay lambat laun preserves that connection between delay, passing time and eventual outcomes.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lambat laun 整块记成“慢归慢，终究会到”：lambat 提醒你“慢”，整个短语提醒你“迟早”。

etymology.historical_story: Lucius was a Roman personal name associated with Latin lux, meaning light. It continued beyond antiquity through historical and religious naming traditions; medieval records preserve Latin Lucius and related vernacular forms. When it appears in Malay today, it identifies a person rather than naming light. Its historical association explains the name, not an ordinary Malay vocabulary meaning. See [DMNES](https://dmnes.org/2019/1/name/Lucius).

etymology.historical_story: Loker belongs to the vocabulary surrounding English locker. Malaysian standard Malay uses lokar, while loker also appears in local institutional writing. The Kuala Lumpur Library's service page illustrates this variation by using both spellings for personal storage facilities. For learners, this is a useful distinction between an encountered spelling and the dictionary headword. Sources: [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=lokar), [Kuala Lumpur Library](https://perpustakaankualalumpur.dbkl.gov.my/perkhidmatan/).

etymology.historical_story: The supplied evidence does not establish a deeper historical origin for lebat. Its documented meanings nevertheless form a memorable cultural picture: luxuriant hair and fruit, heavy tropical rain, and richly patterned cloth. A useful interpretive link is abundance within a space, although that connection is a learning explanation rather than a proven account of semantic development. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=384984&keyword=lebat)

etymology.historical_story: In Unix computing, ls is a compact command name associated with listing directory contents. Malay technical conversation can retain such identifiers unchanged while placing them inside Malay sentences. This explains one possible occurrence of ls in a Malay corpus, but the packet supplies no context establishing that history for this particular token.

etymology.historical_story: Lap is commonly traced to Dutch lap, meaning a piece of cloth or rag. In Malay, the everyday object and the action performed with it are closely connected: kain lap names the cloth, while mengelap names wiping. The borrowed monosyllable also takes Malay affixes, illustrating how an adopted word can become part of a productive local word family. [Etymology reference](https://ms.wiktionary.org/wiki/lap#Etimologi)

etymology.historical_story: Loghat is generally traced to Arabic lughah, meaning language. Malay dictionaries preserve a wider semantic range than today's familiar dialect sense: literal meaning, pronunciation, and vocabulary also appear. The older expression kitab loghat means dictionary. These recorded uses help learners understand older texts without assuming that every occurrence refers to a regional dialect. [Borrowing account](https://arabbahasa.blogspot.com/2011/03/senarai-kata-pinjaman-dari-bahasa-arab.html); [DBP meanings](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82548&keyword=loghat)

etymology.historical_story: Lengannya combines the body-part noun lengan with the attached pronoun -nya. Malay extends the familiar image of an arm to sleeves, balances and even the lines forming an angle. A clothing conversation therefore offers a memorable change of perspective: after mentioning a shirt, lengannya refers to its sleeves. These are dictionary-recorded senses, not evidence of a particular chronological sequence.

etymology.historical_story: Lembik illustrates a familiar Malay meaning pattern: physical texture supplies a vocabulary for human condition. Rice or soil can lack firmness; a tired body can likewise feel limp, and someone's resolve can seem weak. These related uses are documented in Malay dictionaries. They illustrate semantic connections, without establishing a precise historical sequence or deeper ancestral origin.

etymology.historical_story: Malaysian dictionary usage gives lembab a mental-slowness sense, while the closely associated spelling lembap covers dampness and several kinds of sluggishness. This overlap explains why learners encounter similar-looking words in discussions of pupils, computers and wet clothing. The useful cultural distinction is contextual: criticism of a machine is ordinary, but the same adjective applied to a person can sting.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lem.bab 想成反应慢半拍的“慢……半拍”；这是记忆联想，不是词源。

senses.zh_definition: 钱；金钱。用于受本地福建话影响的区域或混合口语，尤其与槟城语言环境有关。
senses.en_definition: Money, in regional or mixed colloquial speech influenced by local Hokkien.

senses.nuances: 这是有地域和接触语言背景的用法，不宜当作全国通用的正式财务词。马来语规范对应词为 wang，日常广泛使用 duit。这里的马来语释义是综合说明，并非声称引自 DBP 的独立 lui 词条。福建话的相关用法见 [China Heritage Quarterly：Penang Hokkien Dictionary](https://chinaheritagequarterly.org/tien-hsia.php?issue=026&searchterm=026_hokkien.inc)。

etymology.historical_story: Lui reflects a round trip through the region's trading languages. A Penang Hokkien dictionary account traces its money sense to Dutch duit, a copper coin, through Malay. In Southeast Asian Hokkien it became a general word for money. Its appearance in mixed local speech illustrates how familiar market vocabulary can circulate across communities. [Source](https://chinaheritagequarterly.org/tien-hsia.php?issue=026&searchterm=026_hokkien.inc)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 会福建话可直接联想表示钱的 lui；不会的话，就把它和马来语 duit 配成一组：lui = duit = 钱。

etymology.historical_story: The cultural life of lambang becomes visible in DBP's own emblem: a lontar leaf evokes earlier writing traditions, while a book and pen represent publishing and writing. Together, these objects show how a concrete image can carry institutional identity and historical memory. This illustrates cultural usage, rather than establishing the word's ultimate origin. [DBP annual report](https://dbp.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2022/08/LAPORAN-TAHUNAN-2019.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lam-bang 联想成“亮出帮派徽章”：看到徽章，就认出它代表谁。此为记忆联想，并非词源。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在这里是附着于名词后的代词性成分，可表示第三人称所属或回指；按给定分类记为 suffix，但不属于派生词缀。词根不发生音变，ny 表示 /ɲ/。输入包的 لمڤو 是词根 lampu 的拼写，完整形式据 lampu + ڽ 补写为 لمڤوڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 他或她的灯；它所配的灯：表示某个人或事物所属、所用或所带的照明装置。

senses.ms_definition: Lampu milik atau kegunaan orang ketiga, atau lampu yang menjadi bahagian sesuatu benda yang dirujuk.
senses.nuances: -nya 本身不区分男性、女性或非人事物，也不保证只有一盏灯；指向由上下文确定。比如 Ali membawa lampunya 指“阿里带着他的灯”，而 kereta itu，lampunya rosak 可指“那辆车的灯坏了”。词根 lampu 的照明装置义见 [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=lampu)。

senses.ms_definition: Lampu yang telah diketahui atau dapat dikenal pasti melalui konteks percakapan, tanpa semestinya menekankan pemiliknya.
senses.nuances: 这是 -nya 的回指或关联用法，常与所属义重叠，并非 lampu 的全新词义。例如进入已谈到的房间后说 lampunya terang，通常可自然译成“灯很亮”。不要把 -nya 当作所有名词都必须添加的定冠词。

etymology.historical_story: Lampunya is a transparent Malay combination rather than a separate inherited root. Its base lampu names a lighting device, while attached -nya connects that device to someone or something already identifiable. The cultural range of lampu extends beyond equipment: Malay dictionary usage also treats a lamp as an image of intellectual or spiritual illumination. That figurative meaning requires an appropriate context. Source: [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=lampu).

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries preserve two cultural settings for lembing: the traditional spear and the sporting javelin. Proverbs also place it beside the keris as an image of physical force, then contrast that force with hurtful speech. This is documented cultural continuity; the dictionary evidence alone does not establish the word's ultimate origin. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=lembing)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 lem-bing 两拍记：第一拍举起长杆，第二拍想象矛头“叮”地扎中靶心；这是联想记忆，不是词源解释。

senses.zh_definition: 滑动、滑行；沿表面顺势移动，尤其指向下滑。
senses.en_definition: To slide or glide along a surface, especially downwards.
senses.ms_definition: Melungsur atau menggelongsor, terutama dari tempat yang lebih tinggi ke tempat yang lebih rendah.
senses.nuances: 标准叙述中常用 meluncur；词根见于 papan luncur、luncur ais 等复合表达。luncur ais 是“滑冰”的复合名称，不能据此把所有独立出现的 luncur 都标成名词。[DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=luncur)。

collocations.zh: 滑行板；具体为冲浪板、滑板等，依语境而定
collocations.en: a board used for sliding or surfing

senses.zh_definition: 滑脱、脱落；从手中、口袋或其他容纳处脱出。
senses.en_definition: To slip free from a hold or out of a place of containment.
senses.ms_definition: Lucut atau terlepas daripada pegangan, poket dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 着重“脱离原来位置”，不一定持续滑行。现代叙述意外滑脱时也常用 terluncur、terlepas 或其他更具体的动词；以下为较少见的词典式搭配。

senses.zh_definition: 失效；尤指典当物因未赎回而丧失赎回权益，也可指约定不再有效。
senses.en_definition: To lapse or be forfeited, especially of an unredeemed pledged item.
senses.ms_definition: Lelap bagi barang gadaian, atau tidak berlaku lagi bagi janji dan sebagainya.
senses.nuances: 属较少见的传统用法。gadaian 语境中的 luncur 不是物品发生物理滑动；正式业务说明通常采用更明确的表述，如 tidak ditebus。

collocations.zh: 典当物已因未赎回而被没收
collocations.en: the pledged item has been forfeited

senses.zh_definition: 快速而顺畅地移动、驶过，常形容车辆。
senses.en_definition: To move swiftly and smoothly, especially of a vehicle.
senses.ms_definition: Bergerak dengan cepat, seperti kereta dan kenderaan lain.
senses.nuances: 实际句子通常使用 meluncur；强调移动的顺畅感，不必然表示违法超速，也不等同于车辆打滑。

senses.zh_definition: 流畅地说出、自然地从口中流出，形容话语。
senses.en_definition: To flow readily from someone's mouth, of words or speech.
senses.ms_definition: Keluar dengan lancarnya, berkenaan kata-kata atau percakapan.
senses.nuances: 主要见于书面叙述和文学表达，常用 meluncur。meluncurkan kata-kata 是及物结构，表示把话流畅地说出来。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary meanings of luncur connect movement with release: a body slides, a vehicle glides, and words flow from the mouth. An older pawning usage describes pledged goods becoming forfeited. These recorded meanings offer a useful cultural picture, although they do not establish which sense developed first or prove an ultimate etymology. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=luncur)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lun-cur 联想“轮子顺畅滑出去”：物体滑行、车子驶过、话语流出，都抓住“顺势移动”的画面；“典当物失效”另作旧义记忆。

morphology.pattern_note: 独立词根；meN- 在 l 前实现为 me-，l 保留，如 meliat。输入音节字段保留 liat。

word_family.gloss: 韧性；难嚼的程度；水的硬度

senses.zh_definition: 有韧性、不易折断或扯断的；指食物时为难切、难嚼的。
senses.en_definition: Tough and resistant to breaking or tearing; difficult to chew when describing food.
senses.ms_definition: Lembut atau boleh dilenturkan tetapi tidak mudah patah atau putus; sukar dikunyah jika berkenaan dengan daging.
senses.nuances: 重点是抗断、难扯或难嚼，不一定坚硬。描述材料可为中性或褒义，描述肉质通常表示口感不佳。释义依据：[DBP PRPM：liat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=liat)。

senses.zh_definition: 黏稠、有黏性的；尤用于土质。
senses.en_definition: Sticky or cohesive in consistency, especially of soil.
senses.ms_definition: Likat atau pekat.
senses.nuances: tanah liat 是固定名称，指黏土；不能把所有含水或泥泞的土都称为 tanah liat。

senses.zh_definition: 顽强、不易被击败或压服的；坚忍的。
senses.en_definition: Tenacious and difficult to defeat or overcome.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak mudah kalah; tabah dan cekal ketika menghadapi tentangan.
senses.nuances: 比喻义，常用于比赛、对手或抵抗；可以表示对对方实力的认可。

senses.zh_definition: 不情愿做某事的；磨蹭、难以催动的。
senses.en_definition: Reluctant or slow to do something; difficult to persuade into action.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak suka atau berasa payah dan segan untuk melakukan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 常接 hendak、nak 或行动动词，强调对某件事不积极，不必然表示此人一贯懒惰。

collocations.en: reluctant to get up in the morning

senses.zh_definition: 硬的，指含有溶解的钙盐或镁盐、难以使肥皂起泡的水。
senses.en_definition: Hard, of water containing dissolved calcium or magnesium salts and lathering poorly with soap.
senses.ms_definition: Sukar menghasilkan buih dengan sabun kerana mengandungi garam kalsium atau magnesium yang terlarut.
senses.nuances: 水质术语，不表示水黏稠，也不等于水脏。释义依据：[DBP PRPM：liat，Kamus Pelajar](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=liat)。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect liat with several everyday experiences: rubber that resists tearing, meat that resists chewing, and a person who resists pressure. These meanings offer a cultural picture of resistance, from cooking to competition. This is a semantic connection useful for learning, rather than a documented chronology of the word's origin. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=liat).

etymology.historical_story: Lockwood is an English habitational surname associated with places bearing that name. The Dictionary of American Family Names connects several such place names with old words for an enclosure and woodland, with regional differences in the woodland element. This history explains an English name; it does not establish a Malay vocabulary item. [Source](https://www.ancestry.com/last-name-meaning/lockwood?geo-lang=en)

senses.zh_definition: 被水流带走；随水流漂移。
senses.en_definition: To drift or be carried away by a current.
senses.ms_definition: Dibawa atau dihanyutkan oleh arus.

senses.zh_definition: 溶解；物质分散于水或其他溶剂中，形成均匀混合物。
senses.en_definition: To dissolve in a solvent and form a homogeneous mixture.
senses.ms_definition: Hancur dan bercampur sekata di dalam air atau pelarut lain, seperti gula atau garam.
senses.nuances: 不及物用法；“使某物溶解”用 melarutkan。“溶解”须与因受热而“熔化”的 melebur 区分。参见 [DBP PRPM：larut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=larut)及 [melarutkan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=206468&keyword=melarutkan)。

senses.zh_definition: 比喻某事物融入另一事物之中，以致原有的独立身份或特征消失。
senses.en_definition: Figuratively, to lose a separate identity by becoming absorbed into something else.
senses.ms_definition: Luput atau hilang identiti tersendirinya kerana terserap ke dalam sesuatu yang lain.
senses.nuances: 属于比喻或文学用法，着重独立特征的消失。下列搭配是体现该义的组合，并非固定习语。参见 [DBP PRPM：larut](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=larut)。

etymology.historical_story: DBP separates larut into entries covering advancing time or conditions, dissolution, and the arrowroot plant. These distinctions prevent an attractive image from becoming a false origin story: a late night and dissolving sugar need not share a proven historical explanation. Learners can connect the images for memory while keeping the botanical homonym separate.

etymology.historical_story: Lara belongs to Malay’s literary vocabulary of sorrow. Its cultural associations are especially vivid in penglipur lara, the traditional storyteller who comforts listeners through entertaining folk narratives, often interwoven with verse. The expression connects emotional pain with the communal pleasure of storytelling. This documents the word’s cultural history rather than establishing its ultimate linguistic origin, which the supplied dictionary entry does not specify. [DBP: penglipur lara](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=penglipur+lara).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 la-ra 想成忧伤歌曲里的两声轻唱：声音轻轻，心里却有哀愁。再连记 pelipur lara＝给哀愁一点慰藉；这是联想记忆，不是词源解释。

morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入包中的直接基底 lupakan；其词汇词根为 lupa。附加 -lah 不改变基底的辅音。这里的 -lah 是后附强调小品词，可缓和祈使语气，不是构成新派生词的后缀。[DBP 小品词说明](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=partikel)

senses.zh_definition: 忘了吧；放下吧。劝对方不再记挂某人、往事或令人难受的经历。
senses.en_definition: Forget it; let go of someone or something emotionally.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk perintah atau nasihat supaya seseorang tidak lagi mengingati atau mengenangkan seseorang, sesuatu perkara atau pengalaman.
senses.nuances: 通常带宾语，也可在语境明确时单独使用。-lah 可表达劝慰，也可因重音而显得不耐烦；并不保证语气温柔。此释义根据 melupakan 的相关义项及 -lah 的语法功能综合表述。[DBP：melupakan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=melupakan)

senses.zh_definition: 算了吧；别再考虑了。劝对方放弃某个打算、要求或当前讨论的事情。

senses.ms_definition: Ungkapan supaya seseorang tidak lagi mempertimbangkan atau meneruskan sesuatu niat, cadangan atau urusan.

etymology.historical_story: This expression brings together the vocabulary of memory and the social work of advice. Its lexical base is lupa, while -kan supplies the transitive form and -lah shapes the appeal to the listener. In everyday reconciliation, the result can invite someone to release an old grievance. The same expression becomes dismissive when delivered sharply.

etymology.historical_story: Lezat belongs to the Arabic-derived vocabulary shared by Indonesian and Malay. Its Malaysian counterpart, lazat, is associated with Arabic laḏḏa, meaning pleasure or delight. The paired spellings show how closely related national standards can preserve different forms of a shared word. A learner may encounter lezat on an Indonesian menu, while Malaysian food writing normally uses lazat. [Malay Language Council journal](https://www.languagecouncils.sg/mbms/my/-/media/mlc/documents/pdfs/sekata/1989_jilid-7-bilangan-1.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Lahir is historically connected with Arabic ẓāhir, meaning outward or apparent. Historical Malay dictionaries document an initial l pronunciation in this borrowing. Modern Malay lahir covers outward appearance and birth, while lahirkan adds the suffix -kan. Bringing something outward provides a useful conceptual link among childbirth, expression and production, rather than a proven sequence of semantic change. See [the historical linguistic study](https://brill.com/view/journals/bki/166/2-3/article-p218_3.pdf).

senses.en_definition: In Kelantan Malay, careless or rash.

senses.nuances: 这是地区方言义，不宜直接当作全国通用的正式形容词。标准马来语可用 cuai、gopoh 或 tidak berhati-hati。DBP 方言记录的发音约为 [lɔ.lɑ̃]；headword.ipa 给出海螺名词按拼写读出的宽式音值。参见 [DBP《吉兰丹方言词汇表》中的 lola](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=la+ni)。

senses.en_definition: A commercially valuable topshell, commonly called siput lola, whose shell is used to make buttons.

etymology.historical_story: Lola connects two distinct Malaysian settings without establishing a shared origin. DBP records it in Kelantan speech for carelessness. In Sabah's maritime history, siput lola appears in accounts of Bajau fishing voyages and shells collected for button making. These documented settings provide cultural anchors; neither establishes the word's ultimate etymology.

etymology.historical_story: Malay label is borrowed from English. Its earlier English history leads to Old French words for a ribbon or strip, a useful image for the small identifying pieces attached to objects. The meaning later extended from a physical tag to a classification and a recording brand. Malay uses the borrowed base productively in melabel and pelabelan. See [label word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/label).

etymology.historical_story: As a given name, Leonard continues a Germanic naming tradition combining an element for “lion” with another for “brave” or “strong”. The Normans carried the name into England, and it developed related forms across European languages. In Malay discourse it remains a person's name, rather than a descriptive word meaning “brave lion”. [Name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/leonard/)

etymology.historical_story: One documented bearer of this name is Lawton, Oklahoma. The city's official history dates its founding to 6 August 1901 and identifies Major General Henry Ware Lawton as its namesake. This explains that particular place-name, but neither identifies the packet's intended referent nor establishes an etymology for a Malay common word. See [City of Lawton](https://www.lawtonok.gov/592/History).

etymology.historical_story: Listrik belongs to Indonesia's history of European language contact. The World Loanword Database identifies Dutch elektriciteit as a source and classifies the Indonesian word as borrowed and unanalyzable. The shortened form should therefore be learned whole. For Malaysian learners, recognizing listrik helps with Indonesian texts while elektrik remains the usual local choice. [WOLD: listrik](https://wold.clld.org/word/712618398375691).

etymology.historical_story: In Malaysian conversation, English level can appear inside otherwise Malay sentences about games, skills, buildings or measurements. The surrounding grammar remains Malay, while the borrowed noun supplies a familiar label. Formal Malay distributes these meanings across words such as tahap, peringkat, aras, tingkat and paras. That contrast makes level a useful window into everyday multilingual language use.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 level 想成一把分格的尺：能力看 tahap，游戏看 peringkat，楼层看 aras 或 tingkat，水位看 paras。

etymology.historical_story: The English word lemon travelled through French and Mediterranean languages, with earlier Arabic and Persian forms behind it. That history reflects the movement of citrus fruits and their names across trading regions. It does not, by itself, establish exactly how Malay acquired lemon; the supplied DBP entry records its meanings rather than its borrowing history. See [lemon: etymology](https://www.etymonline.com/word/lemon).

etymology.historical_story: A short spelling can conceal several unrelated linguistic identities. DBP records English lo as an exclamation, while research on colloquial Indonesian discusses lo among variants of a second-person pronoun associated with Jakarta and Hokkien contact. These uses must not be merged. Without a source sentence, the packet cannot establish which identity belongs to this token. See [research on Indonesian pronouns](https://www.degruyterbrill.com/document/doi/10.1515/9781614516439/pdf).

senses.zh_definition: 覆盖在某物表面的物质或覆盖层。

senses.nuances: 可指积雪、冰等实际覆盖物。与“新闻报道”义须凭后接名词区分。释义依据 [DBP：liput](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=liput)。

senses.zh_definition: 电信、广播或其他服务能够覆盖的地域、范围或程度。
senses.en_definition: The area or extent reached by a network, broadcast, or service.
senses.ms_definition: Kawasan atau tahap jangkauan sesuatu rangkaian, siaran atau perkhidmatan.
senses.nuances: 电信语境中指网络覆盖；有覆盖并不保证网速快。此义是“覆盖”概念的现代应用，见 [雪兰莪州议会：移动网络覆盖](https://dewan.selangor.gov.my/question/liputan-rangkaian-mudah-alih-dan-internet-luar-bandar/)。

senses.zh_definition: 保险或保障计划所涵盖的风险、人员、财物及保障范围。
senses.en_definition: The scope of protection provided by an insurance policy or protection scheme.
senses.ms_definition: Skop risiko, orang atau harta yang dilindungi oleh polisi insurans atau skim perlindungan.
senses.nuances: 属于保险专业用法；也常以 perlindungan 表达保障。liputan insurans 收录于 [DBP：insurance coverage](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=insurance)。

etymology.historical_story: Liputan is formed from liput with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its meanings connect physical covering, such as snow over a mountain, with reporting that covers an event. Contemporary network usage extends the same spatial image to places reached by a signal. This is a useful semantic connection, rather than a claim about when each sense first arose. See [DBP: liput](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=liput).

etymology.historical_story: Limau is an unprefixed Malay plant name whose cultural reach extends beyond fruit. The dictionary records berlimau for bathing with water containing citrus and flowers, alongside numerous named varieties and proverbial expressions. These uses show how citrus entered domestic practices and figurative language. They document cultural associations rather than establish a particular borrowing source or date.

morphology.pattern_note: 这里按国际单位符号处理，不属于可作词根、词缀分析的普通马来语单词。符号本身无固定词汇读音，朗读数值时通常读出单位名称 lumen。

senses.zh_definition: 流明的国际单位符号，用于表示光通量；1 lm = 1 cd·sr。
senses.en_definition: The international symbol for the lumen, the SI unit of luminous flux; 1 lm = 1 cd·sr.
senses.ms_definition: Simbol antarabangsa bagi lumen, iaitu unit SI untuk fluks cahaya; satu lumen bersamaan dengan satu kandela steradian.
senses.nuances: 此处 pos=noun 表示它代替单位名称使用，实际类别是计量符号。输入没有原始语境，因此只能确认 lm 存在这一标准含义，不能断定原语料必指流明。光通量不同于以 lx 表示的照度。依据见 [BIPM 光度测量原则](https://www.bipm.org/documents/20126/41749107/Principles%2Bgoverning%2Bphotometry/8365350c-bf72-3cf2-bf03-324bf5c01b62)。

etymology.historical_story: The letters lm belong to the international language of measurement rather than ordinary Malay word formation. They represent the lumen, a unit of luminous flux. The same symbol appears in scientific documents and lighting specifications across languages, allowing a quantity written on a lamp package to retain its technical meaning internationally. [BIPM photometry principles](https://www.bipm.org/documents/20126/41749107/Principles%2Bgoverning%2Bphotometry/8365350c-bf72-3cf2-bf03-324bf5c01b62)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lumen 的 l、m 两个辅音抓出来记成 lm：看到灯泡标签上的 lm，就想到光通量的单位流明。

senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, pasukan tentera yang besar, khususnya unit tentera Rom purba; takrif ini ialah huraian bahasa Melayu, bukan petikan takrif rasmi DBP bagi ejaan legion.
senses.nuances: 英语还可用 legion 表示大群人，并作形容词表示数量极多；这些不能直接当作马来语义项。PRPM 收录相近拼写 legiun，标注为印度尼西亚来源的古语，但不能据此把输入 legion 自动改写或认证为正式词条。搭配为教学拟例，未作语料频率认证。参见 [Cambridge：legion](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/legion) 与 [DBP：legiun](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=legiun)。

etymology.historical_story: The military meaning offers a concrete historical image: a large formation in the army of ancient Rome. senses.nuances: 这是马来西亚口语中的英语夹用形式；资料包没有提供 DBP 官方释义，本释义为实际用法归纳，不表示其已获 DBP 规范词资格认定。正式表达依语境使用 talian、sambungan Internet、isyarat 或 liputan rangkaian。马来西亚国会逐字记录可见 line 用于手机信号语境。[马来西亚国会会议记录](https://www.parlimen.gov.my/files/hindex/pdf/DR-04022026.pdf)。不要与 lain（别的；不同的）混淆。

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Aduan pelanggan yang menyebut “line tak ada” direkodkan sebagai masalah ketiadaan isyarat rangkaian mudah alih.

dual_scenarios.en: The customer's complaint of “no signal” was recorded as a loss of mobile network signal.

lah 表示解释或轻微无奈。
aku 和 kau 用于熟人之间。

messages.en: Try going over by the entrance. The signal is usually fine there.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 熟人聊天及即时通信中自然常见；正式报告宜改用准确的马来语对应词。正式场景例句通过引用客户原话保留 line。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 向客服反馈时，说明是 tiada isyarat（没信号）、panggilan terputus（通话中断）还是 sambungan Internet perlahan（网络慢），比笼统说 line 有助于表达问题。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 熟人聊天及即时通信中自然常见；正式报告宜改用准确的马来语对应词。正式场景例句通过引用客户原话保留 line。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 向客服反馈时，说明是 tiada isyarat（没信号）、panggilan terputus（通话中断）还是 sambungan Internet perlahan（网络慢），比笼统说 line 有助于表达问题。

etymology.historical_story: This use takes the English word line into otherwise Malay conversation. A term associated with a telephone connection also serves speakers discussing mobile reception or Internet access. Malaysian parliamentary speech documents this everyday usage. It illustrates how an English noun can fit Malay sentence patterns while formal Malay offers more specific alternatives such as talian, isyarat and sambungan.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: line /laɪn/：先想一条通信“线”，再想到手机的信号和连接；正式写作换成 talian 或 isyarat。

morphology.pattern_note: 英语 lock-up 借入后作为完整词根，不拆成马来语词缀。派生 melokap 时，meN- 在 l 前取 me-，保留 l。

senses.zh_definition: 警察拘留室；警局内用于关押被拘留者的房间。
senses.en_definition: A lockup: a room at a police station used to hold detainees.
senses.ms_definition: Bilik di balai polis tempat mengurung orang tahanan.
senses.nuances: 主要指警察拘留设施，与服刑监狱 penjara 有别。被关入 lokap 本身不表示已经被判有罪。规范词典将动词形式列作 melokap。[DBP 词典](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=lokap)。

senses.zh_definition: （口语）把某人关进警察拘留室；拘留某人。
senses.en_definition: Informally, to put someone in a police lockup.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam percakapan, mengurung atau menahan seseorang di dalam lokap; bentuk berimbuhan bakunya ialah melokap.
senses.nuances: 裸词根作动词常见于口语，如 polis lokap dia；正式写作宜用 melokap，或采用更明确的 menahan seseorang di dalam lokap。本义是口语动词用法的归纳，不是把资料包中的名词释义直接改列为官方动词义。

collocations.en: the police put him in a lockup
get locked up by the police

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 涉及本人或家属被拘留时，宜客观使用 ditahan di lokap；避免用带嘲讽意味的 padan muka（活该）等表达。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 新闻、工作汇报和日常转述应区分 tahanan（被拘留者）与 pesalah（违法者），不要仅凭某人进入 lokap 就断言其有罪。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 涉及本人或家属被拘留时，宜客观使用 ditahan di lokap；避免用带嘲讽意味的 padan muka（活该）等表达。
sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 新闻、工作汇报和日常转述应区分 tahanan（被拘留者）与 pesalah（违法者），不要仅凭某人进入 lokap 就断言其有罪。

etymology.historical_story: Lokap comes from English lock-up. The borrowed expression became a single Malay word rather than retaining the English division into two parts. It also supports Malay morphology: melokap means to put someone in a lockup. A linguistic study uses lokap as an example of an English compound absorbed as one lexical unit. [USM linguistic study](https://ejournal.usm.my/kajh/article/download/kajh_vol25-no-1-2018_5/pdf/3571).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把英语 lock-up 连起来听，就接近 lo-kap：门一锁，人被暂时关在警察拘留室。

morphology.pattern_note: 无词缀；马来西亚标准读音中，词尾 k 通常实现为喉塞音 [ʔ]。

senses.zh_definition: 因年代久远、受潮或保存不当而发霉、腐朽或失去原有强度的。
senses.en_definition: Mouldy or decayed through age, dampness, or deterioration.
senses.ms_definition: Bercendawan atau reput kerana sudah lama, buruk atau terdedah kepada kelembapan.
senses.nuances: 常形容木材、布料、纸张等材料，强调霉变或朽坏，而不只是年代久远。形容食物变质时，应按情况使用 basi、rosak 或 berkulat。

senses.zh_definition: 陈旧过时、已经不再适用或失去效用的。
senses.en_definition: Outdated or obsolete; no longer useful or appropriate.
senses.ms_definition: Sudah usang atau ketinggalan zaman sehingga tidak lagi berguna atau sesuai.
senses.nuances: 比喻义，常批评观念、方法或制度跟不上时代，语气通常带贬义。固定搭配 hutang lapuk 指难以收回或无法收回的债款；不是所有旧事物都可称为 lapuk。

dual_scenarios.ms: Pemeriksaan mendapati bahawa beberapa papan lantai di bangunan itu telah lapuk dan perlu diganti.

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 直接说别人的思想 lapuk 容易显得轻蔑。向长辈或上级提出意见时，可说 pendekatan ini mungkin kurang sesuai dengan keadaan semasa，表示这种做法可能不太适合当前情况。

etymology.historical_story: Malay preserves a vivid connection between material decay and outdated ideas in lapuk. The proverb tidak lapuk dek hujan, tidak lekang dek panas describes something enduring despite rain and heat, especially custom. As a learning image, weathered wood helps connect the physical meaning with the figurative judgment that an idea has outlived its usefulness. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=115704&keyword=lapuk)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 想象一块老木板，手一拉就“扑”地碎掉：lapuk＝霉朽；再联想到一碰就站不住脚的陈旧观念。此为联想记忆，并非词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 这是英语整词；末尾 -ue 不是马来语后缀，英语读音只有一个音节。标准马来语对应词为 liga，两者是词汇对应关系，不是加减词缀关系。未核实马来语派生词，词族留空。

senses.zh_definition: 〔英语形式〕由若干运动队或选手组成、在成员之间组织比赛的联盟；亦指其联赛。
senses.en_definition: A group of sports teams or players organized to compete against one another, or its competition.
senses.ms_definition: Kumpulan kelab, pasukan atau pemain yang mengadakan pertandingan sesama anggota; padanan bahasa Melayu ialah liga.
senses.nuances: 马来语正式行文通常使用 liga；league 可见于英语名称及语码转换。英语 IPA 不能当作 liga 的马来语读音。下列搭配分别展示英语名称与马来语对应表达，不把英语拼写标为标准马来语词头。[DBP：league 的对应词 liga](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=liga), [Cambridge：league](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/league)

senses.zh_definition: 〔英语形式〕为共同目标而组成的国家、团体或个人联盟。

senses.ms_definition: Persatuan atau perikatan negara, kumpulan atau individu bagi mencapai tujuan bersama.
senses.nuances: 此义常见于英语组织名称，马来语对应词可为 liga、perikatan 或 persatuan，须依组织名称和语境选择。马来文释义为编辑概括。[DBP：liga 的组织义及名称对应](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=liga), [Cambridge：league](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/league)

senses.zh_definition: 〔英语比喻用法〕能力、质量或成就等方面的等级、档次。
senses.en_definition: A level or class of ability, quality or achievement.
senses.ms_definition: Taraf atau kelas dari segi kebolehan, mutu atau pencapaian.
senses.nuances: 这是英语惯用表达中的引申义，不表示 league 已成为同义的标准马来语词。翻译时宜采用 setaraf、setanding 等自然表达。[Cambridge：league 的等级义及惯用语](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/learner-english/league)

etymology.historical_story: English league covers associations, sporting competitions, comparative levels and an older distance unit. Malay lexicography records liga as its equivalent in several relevant domains. This provides a useful cultural bridge when reading international sporting and organizational names, but the translation relationship alone does not establish when or how liga entered Malay. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=liga), [Cambridge](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/league)

etymology.historical_story: English law entered Old English through contact with Old Norse, illustrating how language contact can carry legal vocabulary between communities. It is therefore an English historical borrowing, rather than a Malay formation. Its appearance in a Malay conversation is best understood as an English insertion unless a particular borrowing is independently established. See [University of Michigan Law School](https://michigan.law.umich.edu/faculty-scholarship/faculty-publications/outlaws-christians-horsemeat-and-writing-uniform-laws-and).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读作 /lɔː/，一个音节；把 law 直接连接「法律」，再配对标准马来语 undang-undang。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -i 接在 layar 后，词尾 r 保留并与 i 构成下一音节。layari 常见于祈使句及第一、第二人称被动结构；一般主动陈述使用 melayari。数据包中的 لاير 是词根 layar 的爪夷文，本条按后缀 -i 补为 لايري。

senses.zh_definition: 浏览、访问互联网或网站，以获取信息；常以指示或邀请的形式出现。
senses.en_definition: Browse or visit the Internet or a website to obtain information.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk melayari tanpa awalan meN- yang bermaksud mencari dan mendapatkan maklumat, data dan sebagainya melalui Internet.
senses.nuances: 常用于 Sila layari laman web…“请访问……网站”。普通主动陈述说 Saya melayari laman web itu；第一人称被动结构可说 laman web yang saya layari。“浏览”本身不表示下载、注册或提交资料。此释义按 DBP 的 melayari Internet 义改写。[DBP：melayari](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=melayari)

senses.zh_definition: 乘船航经、航行于海洋、河流等水域。
senses.en_definition: Sail across or through a sea, river or other stretch of water.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk melayari tanpa awalan meN- yang bermaksud belayar di laut atau sungai dengan kapal atau perahu; mengharungi sesuatu perairan.
senses.nuances: 此义以水域为航经的对象。一般主动陈述用 melayari，例如 melayari lautan；layari 可出现在祈使句及 perairan yang kami layari 等结构中。下列组合示范其水域宾语，不表示这些祈使形式比日常网络义更常见。[DBP：melayari](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=melayari)

etymology.historical_story: Layar means a sail, and melayari describes travelling through waters by boat. Modern Malay extends the same verb to navigating the Internet and finding information. Layari is the form familiar from public notices inviting readers to visit websites. The maritime image offers a memorable bridge between physical travel and digital exploration. [DBP: melayari](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=melayari)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: layar 是“帆”，layari 就像“扬帆驶入”：驶入海域，也驶入网站；看到 Sila layari，就记“请访问”。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词作为词根记忆；两个 ng 均表示 /ŋ/，不是 /nɡ/。

senses.zh_definition: 用于排走雨水或废水的沟渠；常指住宅、街道或建筑物旁的排水沟。
senses.en_definition: A drain or drainage channel carrying away rainwater or wastewater.

senses.nuances: 通常指人工排水设施，不泛指河流，也不必然指地下污水管道。longkang tersumbat 强调堵塞；longkang monsun 指输送大量雨水的季候风排水渠。行政语境中的 perlongkangan 可见于[马来西亚国家档案馆记录](https://ofa.arkib.gov.my/ofa/collection/asset/1082040)。

etymology.historical_story: Longkang is commonly traced to Southern Min Chinese, although the precise borrowing history remains incompletely documented. Its everyday Malaysian meaning is a drainage channel. The word also entered local English, illustrating how an ordinary feature of neighbourhood life can carry vocabulary across languages. [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/longkang)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 longkang 联想成“一条长长的沟”：画面帮助记义；注意它与英语 long 的相似只是记忆联想。

senses.zh_definition: 被拍卖或供拍卖的物品等。

senses.ms_definition: Barang dan sebagainya yang dilelong.

senses.zh_definition: 拍卖；由竞买者出价购买物品或财产的售卖活动。

etymology.historical_story: Lelongan illustrates a productive Malay pattern: lelong takes the suffix -an to name what is auctioned. The dictionary distinguishes this from pelelongan, the act of auctioning. Malaysian public notices also use lelongan for the event itself, showing how an object-related noun can acquire a broader institutional use. [Sources: DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=75076&keyword=lelong), [Ipoh City Council](https://mbi.gov.my/en/sumber/utc-perak?catid=38%3Alatest-info&id=3185%3Anotis-lelongan-awam-semak-info-lanjut-2&view=article).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lelong 是“拍卖”，加 -an 就联想到“拿来拍卖的东西”；看到 lelongan awam，则整体理解为“公开拍卖活动”。

morphology.formula: ∅ + letusan → letusan（按输入词根字段登记）；实际构词：letus + -an → letusan
morphology.pattern_note: is_root、root_word、root_jawi 保留输入值；语言学上 letusan 是 letus 加名词后缀 -an 的派生词，并非不可再分的词根。加缀后 /s/ 成为末音节 san 的声母。参见 [DBP：letusan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=letusan)。

word_family.gloss: 表示爆发、迸发的构词基础

senses.zh_definition: 突然爆裂或爆炸的事件，亦指由此产生的爆响。
senses.en_definition: An explosion or sudden explosive report.
senses.ms_definition: Ledakan, letupan atau bunyi sesuatu yang meletus.
senses.nuances: 可指事件，也可突出声音；具体来源通常由后接名词说明。letusan tembakan 指枪击的爆响或一阵射击；letupan 在一般爆炸叙述中也很常用。

senses.zh_definition: 火山物质从地下喷出的过程或事件；火山喷发。
senses.en_definition: A volcanic eruption.
senses.ms_definition: Peristiwa gunung berapi mengeluarkan lava, abu atau gas dari dalam bumi.
senses.nuances: 这是“爆发”义在火山语境中的具体用法。通常与 gunung berapi 连用；不能把每一次冒烟都称为已发生的 letusan。

senses.zh_definition: 情绪或社会冲突突然、强烈的爆发。
senses.en_definition: A sudden, intense outburst of emotion or conflict.
senses.ms_definition: Kejadian perasaan atau konflik tercetus secara tiba-tiba dan kuat.
senses.nuances: 比喻用法，强调突然性与强度；用于新闻、评论或文学描写较自然。普通不满或轻微争执不一定达到 letusan 的程度。

dah 对应 sudah；je 对应 sahaja。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 词本身语体中性，但 letusan kemarahan 带有较强评价色彩。职场上描述他人情绪时，应说明具体行为，避免轻率给人贴上“大发雷霆”的标签。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适用于灾害、爆响、枪声及冲突报道。涉及真实事故时，应区分听到的爆响与已经确认的原因，避免仅凭声音就断言发生爆炸或枪击。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于灾害、爆响、枪声及冲突报道。涉及真实事故时，应区分听到的爆响与已经确认的原因，避免仅凭声音就断言发生爆炸或枪击。

etymology.historical_story: The revealing history here is word formation rather than a named historical incident. Malay letus supplies the base, while -an turns the action into an event noun. The resulting letusan can describe an explosive report or an eruption. Figurative expressions extend that same sudden release to anger and conflict, preserving the image of pressure breaking outward. [DBP reference](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=letusan).

etymology.historical_story: In this entry, last comes from English rather than from a Malay root. Its appearance in Malay conversation illustrates code-switching: speakers can insert an English word or phrase into an otherwise Malay sentence. etymology.historical_story: The international term ultimately recalls Lesbos, the Greek island associated with the poet Sappho. Her poetry about love between women helped give the geographical name a later identity meaning. Malay uses lesbian as a complete borrowed word; its ending is not a Malay suffix. The packet does not establish when it entered Malay. [American Heritage Dictionary: lesbian](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=Lesbian).

etymology.historical_story: The larang family links personal prohibition with collective rules: melarang names the act, while larangan names a prohibition. In pantang larang, the family also enters discussions of customary restrictions. A separate Minangkabau homonym means 'rarely'; it should not be interpreted as a figurative extension of forbidding. etymology.historical_story: Lampin preserves an older vocabulary of cloth care: dictionaries record both a baby's wrapping cloth and a square cloth used as a nappy. Modern expressions such as lampin pakai buang distinguish disposable products from reusable cloth ones. The Jakarta hand-protecting sense adds another cloth function. These meanings illustrate cultural continuity, but do not establish a particular ancient source language. [DBP meanings](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=lampin) [Disposable and cloth forms](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=lampin+I+1)

etymology.historical_story: Malay builds lakaran from lakar with the result-forming suffix -an. Kamus Dewan records lakar both for a rough drawing and for a boat still being worked on. These meanings invite an image of unfinished work, although their historical relationship is not established here. Today, lakaran connects artistic practice with classroom and professional design. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=lakar)

etymology.historical_story: Lipat is an established Malay root connecting the physical act of folding with the idea of repeated layers or multiples. DBP records both meanings and derivatives such as melipat and lipatan. The connection offers a useful cultural image: folding cloth creates layers, while figurative multiplication creates greater quantities. A specific ancient origin is not established by the supplied evidence. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=lipat)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 按 li.pat 拍两下：第一拍拿起纸边，第二拍压下折好。由“折出多层”联想到“成倍”。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于菜单、食谱及点餐。名称本身不说明配料；有饮食要求时，另问酱汁、肉类及其他成分。

etymology.historical_story: Linguini is a variant spelling of linguine, an Italian pasta name meaning 'little tongues'. The image comes from the narrow, flattened strands, which resemble small tongues rather than round strings. In Malay food writing, the name identifies a pasta shape and can accompany different sauces. Its Italian ending belongs to the borrowed name, not to Malay word formation. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=linguini)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 linguini 想成盘里一条条细长的“小舌头”：长而扁，就是这种意面。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 为后附成分，不是派生后缀；suffix 表示后接位置。位置义 letak 的 e 读 /ə/，词根末尾 k 在常见马来西亚读音中实现为 [ʔ]，ny 表示 /ɲ/。音节为规范补全；数据包的 létak“疲倦、饥饿”属于另一个同形词。

senses.zh_definition: 某物或某地点的位置、所在之处；用于地点谓语时，相当于“位于”。
senses.en_definition: The position or location of something; in locative constructions, where something is situated.
senses.ms_definition: Kedudukan atau tempat sesuatu berada; dalam binaan lokasi, membawa pengertian berada atau terletak di sesuatu tempat.
senses.nuances: 如 Bandar itu letaknya di tepi sungai，表示该城位于河边，不是“把它放下”的命令。-nya 的作用须结合句法理解，不应一律直译为“他的”。本项采用位置义 letak；数据包误配的是另一个读作 létak 的词。依据 [DBP：letak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=letak)。

senses.zh_definition: 比喻问题、价值、优势等所在的关键点或根本之处。
senses.en_definition: The point in which a problem, value or advantage lies, figuratively.
senses.ms_definition: Tempat atau titik tumpuan sesuatu perkara secara kiasan, seperti masalah, nilai atau kelebihan.
senses.nuances: 由“所在位置”引申而来，如 di situlah letaknya masalah itu。这里的地点表达是比喻性的，不涉及实际地址；也可改写为 masalah itu terletak pada…。引申分析依据 [DBP：terletak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=155028&keyword=terletak)。

collocations.en: that is where the problem lies
that is where the advantage lies
