etymology.historical_story: Letaknya illustrates the flexibility of Malay location expressions. A word for position, letak, combines with -nya to identify where something stands. Location also supplies a metaphor for abstract explanations: a problem can have a place where it lies. This is a semantic account, not a claim about an undocumented ancient origin. See [DBP: letak](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=letak).

etymology.historical_story: Luruh is rooted in familiar observations of ripe fruit, falling leaves, and feathers being shed. Malay also uses this image in proverbs about life's changes and mortality. The expression musim luruh names autumn through its falling leaves. A separate classical homonym means territory; identical spelling alone does not establish a shared origin. [Dictionary reference](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=luruh)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 读 lu-ruh，想象一片叶子从枝头轻轻落下：叶、果、发、羽“到时候脱落”，就是 luruh。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 实质上是后附代词，此处按给定字段归入 suffix；ny 表示 /ɲ/，词根不变。资料包的 ليهت 仅拼写词根 lihat，完整 lihatnya 可写为 ليهتڽ；headword.jawi 按原包保留。

senses.ms_definition: Bentuk lihat yang diikuti kata ganti nama singkat -nya, dengan maksud memandang atau melihat orang atau benda yang dirujuk dalam konteks.
senses.nuances: 不应当作具有固定新义的独立词根，也不等于 kelihatannya（看来）。一般正式主动陈述句使用 melihatnya；lihatnya 可出现在省略前缀的表达中。下列搭配展示语法组合，不表示它们是固定高频成语。词根释义见 [DBP：lihat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=lihat)，-nya 的代词性质见 [DBP：人称代词](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=ganti+nama+diri)。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 尊重程度主要取决于称呼和上下文；对长辈、教师或上司说话时，使用 saya 和恰当称谓，避免随意使用 aku。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: 尊重程度主要取决于称呼和上下文；对长辈、教师或上司说话时，使用 saya 和恰当称谓，避免随意使用 aku。

etymology.historical_story: The useful story here is grammatical rather than a separate borrowing history. DBP records lihat as the base for seeing and looking, while -nya is a shortened third-person pronoun attached to another word. Together they can point back to someone or something already mentioned; context supplies the referent. [Sources: DBP lihat](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=lihat), [DBP pronouns](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?d=175768&keyword=ganti+nama+diri).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lihat＝看，-nya＝前面提过的他／她／它；合起来就是把目光投向那个对象。

etymology.historical_story: Luther is treated here as a personal name, not as an established Malay common noun. One prominent bearer, Martin Luther, wrote the Ninety-Five Theses in 1517, a central document of the Protestant Reformation. The Library of Congress records early printed editions of that work. This historical association explains a likely reading context, but it does not establish the surname's etymology or identify every occurrence. [Library of Congress](https://www.loc.gov/resource/gdcwdl.wdl_07497/?st=pdf)

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect liang with openings ranging from a needle's eye to spaces used in burial. DBP illustrates the puncture sense with a passage involving Laksamana and Jebat, placing the word within Malay literary memory. This documents an established cultural use; it does not establish a particular borrowing source or a dated first appearance. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=liang)

morphology.pattern_note: 按伊斯兰术语 li'an 的无撇号形式处理，整词记忆，不作马来语词缀拆分。IPA 为马来语适应性参考读音，并非数据包提供的实测读音；原词中的阿拉伯语辅音可能在宗教诵读中保留。无已核实的马来语派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 伊斯兰婚姻法中的相互诅誓程序：丈夫就妻子通奸或否认子女亲缘提出指控并按规定宣誓，妻子可通过相应誓言否认指控。
senses.en_definition: A prescribed Islamic procedure of sworn accusation and counter-oath between spouses concerning alleged adultery or disputed paternity.
senses.ms_definition: Prosedur sumpah tertentu dalam hukum Islam apabila suami menuduh isterinya berzina atau menafikan nasab anak, dengan sumpah balas oleh isteri untuk menolak tuduhan tersebut.
senses.nuances: 本条按宗教术语 li'an 解读；缺少原始语境，不能排除同形姓名等其他所指。马来西亚宗教机构常写 li’an 或 li‘an。马来语释义为依据来源编写的释义，并非 DBP 引文；status 按指定格式保留，不表示已核实该词形获得 DBP 认可。参见[槟城州宗教司署：Konsep Li’an Di Dalam Islam](https://ekemusykilan.penang.gov.my/bank_detail.php?id=WCwMMg%3D%3D)。

etymology.historical_story: The term belongs to the Arabic vocabulary of Islamic jurisprudence. Its historical setting is the solemn exchange of oaths described in Surah al-Nur, verses 6–9, rather than an ordinary marital argument. In Malay religious writing, the spelling li’an helps signal its Arabic origin. The form lian omits that transliteration mark. [Source: Penang Mufti Department](https://ekemusykilan.penang.gov.my/bank_detail.php?id=WCwMMg%3D%3D).

etymology.historical_story: Lekaslah has a transparent formation: lekas expresses speed or promptness, while attached -lah adds emphasis shaped by context and intonation. Its interest lies in interaction rather than an exotic borrowing story: a short everyday expression can encourage, plead, or hurry someone along. The supplied evidence does not establish the deeper historical origin of lekas.

senses.zh_definition: 水蛭；蛭类动物，身体柔软，外形似山蛭，在日常马来语中通常指比 pacat 较大的种类。

etymology.historical_story: A linguistic study of Pigafetta's 1521 Malay vocabulary identifies his spelling linta with modern lintah, illustrating how a listener could fail to record final h. The word also anchors the expression lintah darat: the blood-feeding animal provides an image for a lender who extracts excessive interest. morphology.pattern_note: 英语天文表达通常写作 light-year 或 light year，由 light + year 构成复合词，并非马来语加缀。作为片名或角色名称的一部分时写作 Lightyear。未建立马来语派生词族。

senses.ms_definition: Tahun cahaya, iaitu unit jarak yang bersamaan dengan jarak yang dilalui cahaya dalam vakum selama satu tahun Julian.
senses.nuances: 此义按英语 light-year 理解；规范马来语对应词为 tahun cahaya。光年计量距离。输入缺乏上下文，不能确定原始词例是否属于此义；未核实 lightyear 为正式马来语词条。定义参见 [IAU 天文教育词汇表](https://www.astro4edu.org/resources/glossary/term/178/)，马来语词形参见 [DBP：tahun cahaya](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=tahun+cahaya)。下列搭配采用马来语对应表达。

senses.ms_definition: Nama khas yang digunakan sebagai judul filem animasi Pixar, Lightyear, dan sebagai sebahagian daripada nama watak Buzz Lightyear.
senses.nuances: 专名应保留大写形式；影片标题和角色名字不宜机械翻译为 tahun cahaya。此处列出已核实的专名用法，原始词例仍需上下文消歧。参见 [Pixar：Lightyear](https://www.pixar.com/lightyear)。

etymology.historical_story: The English compound light-year combines light with year to express an astronomical distance through a travel interval. Malay expresses the same concept as tahun cahaya. The joined spelling Lightyear also appears as a fictional name and film title, so capitalization and context help distinguish scientific measurement from entertainment. See [IAU](https://www.astro4edu.org/resources/glossary/term/178/) and [Pixar](https://www.pixar.com/lightyear).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: light 是“光”，year 是“年”：想象光连续跑一年，它跑过的路程就是一光年。

etymology.historical_story: Laki belongs to a Malay word family that also includes laki-laki and lelaki. Its cultural interest lies in register: an everyday household word can sound noticeably rougher than its polite alternative. DBP marks the husband sense as less refined, making the choice between laki and suami a small but revealing social decision. See [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=169476&keyword=laki).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: la-ki 两拍，联想熟人聊天里的“老公”；正式称“丈夫”时换成 suami。

etymology.historical_story: English leave brings together two historically different words. The verb developed from Old English læfan, associated with letting something remain. The noun came from Old English leaf, meaning permission. Its workplace meaning preserves that idea: leave is an authorised absence. Their identical modern spelling and pronunciation conceal separate histories, rather than one simple development from departure to holiday. See [Etymonline: leave](https://www.etymonline.com/word/leave).

senses.en_definition: A non-SI unit of radiant energy per unit area, equal to one calorie per square centimetre.
senses.ms_definition: Unit bukan SI bagi tenaga sinaran per unit luas, bersamaan dengan satu kalori bagi setiap sentimeter persegi.
senses.nuances: 此处按可核实的科学单位义收录，但原数据包缺少上下文，不能确定原始词频实例是否属于此义；Langley 也可为外国人名或地名。未核实其作为马来语规范词目的 DBP 收录情况，status 字段不能作为此种认证。单位本身表示能量除以面积；表示通量密度还须除以时间。以下搭配为专业用法，不声称属于日常高频搭配。参见 [美国气象学会术语表](https://glossary.ametsoc.org/wiki/langley/)。

etymology.historical_story: The unit commemorates Samuel Pierpont Langley, an American scientist known for research on solar radiation. Its name preserves a person's contribution rather than a Malay root meaning. Older radiation records may express accumulated energy in langleys and rates in langleys per minute, making the distinction between energy and power essential when interpreting historical measurements. [Source: American Meteorological Society](https://glossary.ametsoc.org/wiki/langley/).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 langley 联想成“阳光量格”：在一平方厘米的小格上累计辐射能量；这是记忆联想，不是词源。

etymology.historical_story: Malay lagu connects several familiar cultural experiences: a song, the melody of a recitation, a musical style, and even a person's manner. These meanings show how patterned sound and patterned behaviour can share one expression. Adding the attached pronoun -nya places that song, tune, or manner into a particular relationship: someone's song or the tune already under discussion.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 lagu＝歌，再把 -nya 当作“他／她的、刚提到的”：lagunya＝他／她的歌，或那首歌；ny 要连读成 [ɲ]。

etymology.historical_story: The Clan Lockhart Society connects the surname with earlier spellings such as Locard and Lokart. Its family tradition associates the later spelling with the casket containing Robert the Bruce's heart. This is a clan origin narrative, rather than proof that every bearer shares one ancestry or that the name literally means a locked heart. [Clan Lockhart Society](https://clan-lockhart.org/history/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 用英语 lock 与 heart 的近似声音联想“锁住的心”，记住姓氏 Lockhart；这只是记忆图像，不是确定的词源拆分。

senses.ms_definition: Sejenis serangga yang lazimnya berwarna perang gelap, berbadan leper dan bujur serta mempunyai sesungut panjang dan bahagian mulut menggigit; kepuyuk.
senses.nuances: 指蟑螂这一类昆虫，并非仅指某一个物种。量词用 ekor，如 seekor lipas。seperti lipas kudung 是整体理解的比喻，形容行动迅速或做事麻利，不构成 lipas 单独使用时的新义项。

etymology.historical_story: Malay turns a familiar household insect into an image of remarkable speed. In seperti lipas kudung, the cockroach evokes someone moving rapidly and working briskly. This traditional comparison gives the ordinary insect name a second cultural life: an unwelcome creature becomes a memorable model of energetic action. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=lipas)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 li-pas 联想成“立刻跑散”：一开灯，蟑螂马上四散。只是记忆联想，不是词源。

morphology.formula: boleh − bo- → leh（词首截短；非去前缀）
morphology.pattern_note: 保留输入包的独立词头标记；词源上是 boleh 省去首音节 bo- 的口语形式。bo- 在这里不是前缀，leh 也不是后缀。

word_family.gloss: 可以；能够；leh 对应的完整形式
能力；由完整形式 boleh 派生
使能够；准许；由完整形式 boleh 派生

senses.zh_definition: 能够；可以做到。boleh 的口语截短形式，用于表达能力或条件上的可行性。
senses.en_definition: Can; be able to. A colloquial shortened form of boleh expressing ability or feasibility.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk singkat dalam percakapan bagi boleh yang menyatakan kemampuan atau kemungkinan melakukan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 功能上属于助动词，对应马来语 kata bantu ragam。通常放在主要动词之前，如 leh datang。这里依据输入包处理 boleh 的截短形式，不与 Manglish 中同形的句末语气词混同。截短形式见[Hoogervorst 的口语研究](https://tufs.repo.nii.ac.jp/record/1384/files/nusa5803.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 可以；获准做某事。用于询问、给予或否定许可。
senses.en_definition: May; be allowed to. Used to ask for, grant, or deny permission.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk singkat dalam percakapan bagi boleh yang menyatakan izin atau kebenaran melakukan sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 例如 Leh masuk? 可以是询问“可以进去吗？”，而不是问身体能力。正式书写用 boleh。能力义与许可义的区分参见[DBP 词条 boleh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=259120&keyword=boleh)。

sociolinguistic_register.politeness_note: leh 很随意，适合熟人聊天。向长辈、客户或不熟悉的人请求许可时，用完整的 Bolehkah saya… 更清楚得体。

etymology.historical_story: Leh illustrates a familiar shortcut in informal Malay: speakers retain the end of a longer word and omit its beginning. Here, boleh loses its first syllable, leaving leh with the modal meaning intact. Research on West Malaysian youth language records this shortening. It is clipping, not the removal of a grammatical prefix. [Hoogervorst, 2015](https://tufs.repo.nii.ac.jp/record/1384/files/nusa5803.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: boleh 把开头 bo 收起来，就剩 leh：“可以”也说得更短。看到 leh + 动词，先还原成 boleh + 动词。

morphology.pattern_note: 按整词记忆，不能把 lon- 或 -ceng 拆成马来语词缀。参考读音中 c 为 /t͡ʃ/、ng 为 /ŋ/，e 为前元音而非 /ə/；此音标不代表已核实的马来西亚规范读音。输入未提供音节或 Jawi，均保留 null。未核实该形式的马来西亚规范派生词族。

senses.zh_definition: 钟；铃；敲击或摇动时发出清脆声音的器具。此形式常见于印尼语，马来西亚标准语通常写作 loceng。
senses.en_definition: A bell; an Indonesian form corresponding to standard Malaysian Malay loceng.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk Indonesia yang sepadan dengan loceng, iaitu alat yang menghasilkan bunyi nyaring apabila dipukul atau digoyangkan.
senses.nuances: nonstandard 仅针对马来西亚规范词形，不是否定其在其他语言或地区的使用。PRPM 的 lonceng 查询未显示现行词典释义，并提示 loceng；因此不能标作马来西亚独立规范词条。以下搭配展示 lonceng 的印尼语用法；马来西亚正式文本改用 loceng。依据：[DBP：lonceng 查询](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=lonceng)、[DBP：loceng](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=74812&keyword=loceng)。本马来语释义为对应说明，并非 DBP 对 lonceng 的原文释义。

etymology.historical_story: A reader moving between Indonesian and Malaysian texts may meet lonceng in one book and loceng in another. The contrast illustrates how closely related language standards can preserve different word forms. DBP records loceng for the Malaysian bell. The evidence consulted does not establish the precise borrowing route of lonceng, so a specific donor-language story is not asserted here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 听到末尾 ceng，联想铃声“铛”；再记马来西亚规范拼写 loceng 中没有 n。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 适用于催交文件、付款或尽快处理事务。公开指责某人 sengaja melengahkan urusan，会暗示对方故意拖延，应有事实依据。

etymology.historical_story: Malay dictionaries connect lengah with both inattention and slowness. Adding -kan turns that condition into something caused or prolonged: a task is held up, or someone is distracted. The practical warning jangan lengahkan therefore links attention with timely action. This is a transparent Malay formation; no specific foreign borrowing history is established here.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lengah 是“磨蹭、疏忽”，加 -kan 就让事情跟着慢下来：jangan lengahkan＝别再拖。

word_family.gloss: 湿度；潮湿状态；发展迟缓

senses.zh_definition: 潮湿的；尚未完全干燥的；空气中水汽较多的。
senses.en_definition: Damp or moist; not completely dry; humid when describing air or climate.
senses.ms_definition: Masih mengandungi air atau belum kering sepenuhnya; berkeadaan banyak wap air apabila merujuk udara atau iklim.
senses.nuances: 可形容毛巾、土壤、墙面或空气。通常强调有湿气，不表示物体正在滴水；相较 basah，常突出未干透或微湿。义项依据 [PRPM：lembap](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132444&keyword=lembap)，马来语释义为整理表述。

senses.zh_definition: 声音、音乐或表演缺乏活力、响亮度或明快感的。
senses.en_definition: Lacking liveliness, resonance, or vigour, especially of sound or music.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak rancak, kurang nyaring atau kurang bertenaga, khususnya tentang suara, bunyi-bunyian atau muzik.
senses.nuances: 这一义项较依赖音乐或声音语境，不宜一律译成“缓慢”；重点可能是声音沉闷、演奏乏力或气氛不活跃。

senses.zh_definition: 活动、交易、工作或发展迟缓、欠活跃的；用于人时可贬指反应或学习进展迟缓。

etymology.historical_story: Lembap belongs to the everyday Malay vocabulary of moisture: cloth that has not dried, damp earth, and humid air. Its dictionary meanings also encompass subdued sound and sluggish activity. These meanings offer a useful cultural connection between physical conditions and perceived vitality, although their historical order should not be assumed. Modern skincare vocabulary keeps the same root visible in pelembap, meaning moisturiser.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 念 lem-bap，想象拍到一条没干透的毛巾：触感潮潮的，就是 lembap；市场没活力，也可说 lembap。

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan labels laden as Javanese in origin. Its derivatives connect two everyday acts: attending to a customer and responding to another person's words. etymology.historical_story: LAN has two separate acronym histories in Malaysian usage. In education, it names Lembaga Akreditasi Negara, which was dissolved when MQA was established in 2007. In computing, it preserves the English initials of Local Area Network. The identical spelling therefore links unrelated institutional and technological meanings; context, rather than Malay affixes, tells readers which meaning is intended. etymology.historical_story: Lost belongs to the English lose word family: it serves as an irregular past form and also as an adjective. etymology.historical_story: English lift developed from a verb meaning to raise, traced to Old Norse lypta. The noun later acquired the meaning of a machine carrying passengers between floors. Malay uses the adapted spelling lif for that machine. The supplied spelling lift retains the English final consonant and is best understood here as an English insertion. [English word history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/lift), [DBP terminology](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=lift).

etymology.historical_story: Malay lawan brings together ideas that English often separates: an opponent, an equal, an opposite, and a suitable partner. Traditional food pairings preserve the partner sense, while sports reporting foregrounds competition. Lawannya adds the attached pronoun -nya; it does not introduce a separate historical root. Context reveals whether the relationship is matching, contrasting, or opposing. [DBP: lawan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=123312&keyword=lawan).

etymology.historical_story: Luaran is transparently formed from luar, meaning outside, with the suffix -an. Its dictionary senses preserve several boundaries: outside a group, outside the royal court, beyond one's country, and outward appearance. The court-related sense is marked as classical. Together, these meanings show how physical location can provide a framework for social membership and visible appearance.

etymology.historical_story: Lucian belongs to a European naming tradition rather than a productive Malay word family. Etymological references trace it through Latin Lucianus to the Roman name Lucius, traditionally associated with lux, meaning light. Malay writing also uses Lucian when discussing the ancient writer. That occurrence illustrates the circulation of a personal name, rather than the creation of a Malay common noun. [Etymonline](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Lucian), [《Sekata》2023](https://www.languagecouncils.sg/mbms/my/-/media/mlc/documents/pdfs/sekata/2023-sekata-2023.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 实验室；英语 laboratory 的截短形式，可出现在马来语口语的语码转换中，规范马来语对应词为 makmal。

etymology.historical_story: Lab is an English clipping of laboratory, formed by retaining the beginning rather than adding an affix. DBP's terminology guide uses lab(oratory) to illustrate this shortening process, while its English–Malay dictionary translates lab as makmal. These references support the English source and Malay equivalent, rather than treating lab as a native Malay formation. [DBP terminology guide](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/umum_istilah.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: laboratory 太长，口语截短成 lab；遇到正式马来语写作，就联想到对应词 makmal。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根无词缀；meN- 遇 l 时采用 me-，保留 l，形成 melarat。ter- 形成 terlarat。不同同形词及其派生词不宜强行归为同一语义。

word_family.gloss: 不断延续；越扯越远，另有词根重叠
蔓延；加剧；也有穷困、困苦之义

senses.zh_definition: 有足够的体力、精力或承受能力去做某事；常用于否定结构，表示累得做不动或承受不了。
senses.en_definition: Having sufficient strength, energy, or capacity to do or endure something.
senses.ms_definition: Berdaya atau mempunyai kemampuan untuk melakukan atau menanggung sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 现代日常交流尤其常见于 tak larat、tidak larat。重点通常是体力或承受程度，不能机械等同于“不想做”；也不通常单独表示财力足够。[DBP 各同形词释义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=larat)。

senses.zh_definition: 随水流漂走；也指船锚拖移、未能牢牢固定船只。
senses.en_definition: To drift with the current; of an anchor, to drag rather than hold.
senses.ms_definition: Hanyut atau beralih dibawa arus; tentang sauh, tidak dapat mencengkam dasar sehingga beralih.
senses.nuances: 属于航海或较传统的表达。sauhnya larat 指锚未能抓牢，并不一定表示锚绳断裂。

collocations.en: a boat drifting with the current

senses.zh_definition: 某种状态继续扩大、加剧或拖长；谈话等不断延伸、越扯越远。
senses.en_definition: To intensify, extend, or continue increasingly; to range further or drag on.
senses.ms_definition: Semakin bertambah dari segi luas, lama atau kuatnya sesuatu keadaan, atau berlanjutan semakin jauh.
senses.nuances: 裸词 larat 多见于传统表达；现代说明蔓延常用 melarat，说明谈话拖长常用 berlarat-larat。不能将此义与“有力气”的 larat 混淆。

collocations.en: growing more intense as time passes

senses.zh_definition: 心中悲伤、思绪纷扰或游移不定；主要用于传统或文学性表达。
senses.en_definition: Sorrowful or unsettled in heart or mind, chiefly in literary expressions.
senses.ms_definition: Sedih atau tidak menentu keadaan hati dan fikiran, terutama dalam ungkapan sastera.
senses.nuances: larat hati、larat fikiran 带文学色彩；日常表示疲累的 tak larat 通常不是“悲伤”的意思。

senses.zh_definition: 植物名固定组合 akar larat 的组成部分，指 Melodorum 属的某些攀援灌木。
senses.en_definition: An element of the plant name akar larat, referring to climbing shrubs of the genus Melodorum.
senses.ms_definition: Unsur dalam nama akar larat, iaitu sejenis pokok renek memanjat daripada genus Melodorum.
senses.nuances: 这是植物名中的受限用法，不表示 larat 单独就是所有攀援植物的通称。以下为植物名称及其扩展短语，并非日常高频搭配。

collocations.zh: 名为 akar larat 的攀援灌木
collocations.en: a climbing shrub known as akar larat

etymology.historical_story: Larat appears in traditional descriptions of drifting anchors, extending troubles, and sorrowful hearts. Malay decorative terminology also includes awan larat, whose linked motifs spread across a surface. These uses offer memorable cultural imagery, but they do not prove that every sense shares one historical origin. The everyday ability sense, especially tak larat, should therefore be learned separately.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先整块记 tak larat＝“撑不住、没力气”；另画一只走锚漂远的船，帮助记住 larat 的漂移、延展义。

etymology.historical_story: Lionel comes from French naming traditions, with historical forms associated with a young or little lion. The name also appears in medieval Arthurian literature, long before its modern sporting and musical associations. In Malay it functions as a person's name: its historical animal meaning does not become an ordinary Malay definition. [Etymonline：Lionel](https://www.etymonline.com/word/Lionel)、[Behind the Name：Lionel](https://www.behindthename.com/name/lionel).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Lionel，联想英语 lion 和“小狮子”的历史意象，再记住它是人名；称呼真人时使用本人的实际读音。

morphology.pattern_note: -kan 构成使动动词，表示使某对象失去活动或运作能力；词根末尾 h 保留。完整主动形式为 melumpuhkan；lumpuhkan 可用于祈使句和特定无 meN- 句式。headword.jawi 依资料包保留，但 لومڤوه 只对应词根 lumpuh，未包含后缀。

senses.zh_definition: 使身体或身体部位失去正常活动能力。
senses.en_definition: To cause a person or body part to lose normal movement or function.
senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan tubuh atau anggota badan kehilangan keupayaan untuk bergerak atau berfungsi seperti biasa.
senses.nuances: 这是使动义，不等于表示自身状态的 lumpuh。lumpuhkan 是无 meN- 形式；一般主动陈述句使用 melumpuhkan。本条是依据 [PRPM：lumpuh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=lumpuh+) 综合转述的释义。

senses.zh_definition: 使组织、网络、服务或行动失去运作能力；予以瓦解或重创。
senses.en_definition: To cripple, disable, or stop the effective operation of an organisation, system, service, or activity.
senses.ms_definition: Menyebabkan sesuatu organisasi, sistem, perkhidmatan atau kegiatan tidak dapat beroperasi dengan berkesan.
senses.nuances: 新闻标题常省略 meN-，如 Polis lumpuhkan sindiket；正式完整句通常写 Polis melumpuhkan sindiket。本义强调严重削弱或停止运作，不只是一般的减速。

etymology.historical_story: Lumpuhkan is transparently formed from lumpuh with the causative suffix -kan. The dictionary connects bodily incapacity with the inability of collective work to continue. This shared image supports expressions about disabling operations or dismantling criminal networks. The word therefore illustrates productive Malay word formation and metaphorical extension; it does not require an invented foreign ancestor or a dated origin story.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lumpuh 是“瘫痪”，加 -kan 就变成“使……瘫痪”：状态 → 使动。

morphology.pattern_note: 借词在现代马来语中作为完整词根使用；派生词 meloterikan 的构成为 meN- + loteri + -kan，l 前使用 me-，保留词首 l。

word_family.gloss: 将某物以抽签方式分配或抽奖送出

senses.zh_definition: 彩票抽奖；通过抽签或抽取号码决定中奖者的博彩或奖品分配活动。
senses.en_definition: A lottery or prize draw in which winners are determined by chance.
senses.ms_definition: Undian untuk menentukan pihak yang menerima hadiah; juga sejenis permainan judi yang menentukan tiket pemenang melalui undian.
senses.nuances: 依据《Kamus Dewan》的 undian 义及《Kamus Pelajar》的博彩释义整理。此处强调随机抽奖，不指选举投票。免费的 cabutan bertuah 与付费博彩不能仅凭“抽奖”概念混为一谈。派生词 meloterikan 也见同一词条。[来源：DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=139128&keyword=loteri)。

senses.zh_definition: 彩票；印有号码、用于参加抽奖并确定获奖资格的票券。
senses.en_definition: A lottery ticket bearing numbers used to determine eligibility for a prize.
senses.ms_definition: Surat atau kertas undian untuk menentukan orang yang bernasib baik menerima hadiah.
senses.nuances: 这是由抽奖活动转指其票券的用法，相当于 tiket loteri。menang loteri 或 kena loteri 可指中奖，也可比喻走大运；比喻义属于整个短语的用法。[来源：DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=139128&keyword=loteri)。

etymology.historical_story: Loteri belongs to an international vocabulary of drawing lots. Related European forms include English lottery, French loterie, and Dutch loterij, historically associated with the idea of a lot or allotted share. The precise immediate borrowing route into Malaysian Malay is not established by the supplied packet. Malay dictionaries record both the draw and its ticket, linking an event with its physical token. [Sources: European history](https://www.etymonline.com/word/lottery), [Malay senses](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=139128&keyword=loteri).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 loteri 和英语 lottery 连起来：一张 tiket loteri，等一次 cabutan loteri；同一个词连接“彩票”和“开奖”。

etymology.historical_story: Loomis is documented as an English surname. Family-history accounts connect it with older place-based surname forms in Lancashire, although details of the historical interpretation vary. Such a name can appear unchanged inside a Malay sentence. That possibility explains the token without inventing a Malay root, but the packet alone cannot identify its bearer or establish a Malay dictionary meaning.

senses.zh_definition: 衣物等被揉弄、挤压而皱巴巴、失去平整。

senses.ms_definition: Renyuk atau kumal, terutama tentang pakaian.
senses.nuances: 着重外观被揉皱，不一定已经穿旧或破损；须根据上下文与长期使用造成的破旧义区分。

senses.zh_definition: 衣物、布料等因长期使用而磨损、褪色或显得陈旧。
senses.en_definition: Worn, faded, or shabby from prolonged use.
senses.ms_definition: Rosak, luntur atau usang akibat penggunaan yang lama, terutama tentang kain dan pakaian.

senses.nuances: 属于引申用法，常见于人物描写。比单纯表示疲倦的 letih 更强调外观失去生气；不同于表示乏力、精神不振的 lesu。

etymology.historical_story: The dictionary meanings of lusuh connect cloth with human appearance: fabric becomes crumpled or worn, while a person may look careworn after suffering. This is a useful cultural image rather than proof of a particular historical origin. Remember the shared impression of lost freshness; the dictionary entry does not establish a deeper borrowing history. [PRPM: lusuh](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=lusuh).

etymology.historical_story: Lebihan belongs to the Malay family built around lebih, which expresses more, an excess, or a remainder. Adding -an gives a name to the extra portion itself. The same everyday idea applies to food left after a meal and to quantities recorded in trade, making the word useful across domestic and institutional settings. [Source: DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=132444&keyword=lebihan).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lebih 表示多；加 -an，把“多”变成“多出来的那一份”：lebihan，就是剩余或盈余。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此为后附代词，通常指前文提到的路线、事物或经历；不是派生后缀。ny 表示 /ɲ/。lalui 是直接构词基础，最终词根是 lalu。

senses.ms_definition: Menempuh atau melintasi jalan, laluan atau tempat yang telah disebut; bentuk lalui yang menerima unsur -nya.
senses.nuances: 正式主动陈述句通常使用 melaluinya；祈使句可用 laluinya。-nya 已承接宾语，勿再机械添加同一个宾语。此处马来文释义为编写释义，相关基础义参见 [DBP：melalui](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=250764&keyword=melalui)。

etymology.historical_story: Rather than a separate borrowed word, laluinya shows Malay grammar assembling meaning in layers. The movement word lalu supports lalui, while attached -nya points back to something already mentioned. A physical journey can also frame an emotional experience: the same construction helps speakers describe crossing a passage or getting through a difficult period.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lalui 是“经过”，-nya 把手指向前文：经过“它”，或熬过“那件事”。

etymology.historical_story: The palm and manuscript noun belongs to the region's leaf-writing tradition. Scholarship connects lontar with Javanese rontal, combining ron, meaning leaf, and tal, meaning palmyra palm, through sound transposition. The writing material also became a name for the manuscript. This account concerns the noun; it does not establish the origin of the throwing verb. [Scholarly discussion](https://www.oxis.org/p-z/pelras-christian/pelras-2016.pdf)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 投掷义记搭配 lontar bola；植物义记 daun lontar，再由“叶片”联想到“叶上抄本”。两条记忆线分开。

senses.ms_definition: Nama diri perempuan yang dieja Lydia.

senses.nuances: 历史地理专名，与人名义须依上下文区分；不是现代国家名称。名称的古代地理背景见 [Dictionary of Medieval Names from European Sources](https://dmnes.org/2016/3/name/Lydia)。以下为历史语境中的自然组合。

etymology.historical_story: Lydia links a personal name with an ancient place. Its Greek background points to Lydia, a kingdom in Asia Minor. A New Testament woman also bore the name and was later honored as a saint. Historical naming records therefore connect geography, religious tradition, and personal naming without implying that every modern bearer shares a particular faith. [Historical name dictionary](https://dmnes.org/2016/3/name/Lydia)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 人名 Lydia 记作“莉迪娅”；遇到 kerajaan Lydia，就切换为历史地名“吕底亚王国”。

etymology.historical_story: Lainey belongs to English personal naming rather than an established Malay derivational family. It is documented as a feminine given name or nickname associated with several longer names, including Elaine and Delaney. These different naming routes mean that a particular person's name should not automatically receive one fixed ancestral meaning. See [Lainey](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Lainey).

word_family.gloss: 使消失的行为；钱财的消失或被转移

senses.zh_definition: 消失的；不见踪影的；原有的人、物或事物已不再可见或存在。
senses.en_definition: Gone or no longer present or visible; vanished or missing.
senses.ms_definition: Tidak ada lagi, hilang atau lenyap.
senses.nuances: 强调消失或不见的状态，常带突然、彻底或难以寻回的语感，但这些并非每次使用都必然包含。可说 wang lesap，也可用于 kabus 等自然现象；词本身不说明消失原因。及物表达使用 melesapkan。[DBP PRPM：lesap](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=54140&keyword=lesap) 将其列为形容词。

etymology.historical_story: Lesap is recorded in Malay dictionaries as a basic word for something that is gone or has vanished. Its derivatives move from a state to an action: melesapkan means causing disappearance, while pelesapan names that act. Dictionary examples involving company money illustrate its force in accounts of loss without establishing a deeper historical origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 le.sap 的短促收尾配上“啪，一下不见”的画面：东西突然没了，就是 lesap。此为记忆联想，不是词源。

morphology.pattern_note: 后缀 -an 接在 libur 后构成表示假日或休假时段的名词，词根拼写不变。资料包将整词判为词根，此处按 libur 的派生结构校正。

senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》将其列于标有 Jw，即爪哇语来源标记的 libur 词族。liburan 在印度尼西亚语境中尤其常见；马来西亚日常与行政表达通常使用 cuti。名词 liburan 不应直接替代正式马来语中表示度假动作的 bercuti。[DBP：libur 与 liburan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=libur)

etymology.historical_story: Kamus Dewan places liburan within the libur family and marks the base as Javanese in origin. The word is especially familiar through Indonesian usage, where holidays are commonly discussed with this vocabulary. For Malaysian learners, it offers a useful reminder that closely related regional varieties can share an understandable word while preferring different everyday expressions.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: libur 是休假，接 -an 得到假期 liburan；联想旅行时的假期，但记住休假也可以待在家里。

morphology.pattern_note: -lah 是后附强调小品词，并非派生词缀；suffix 在此仅表示后接位置。拼写连写，词根不变。输入 Jawi لاون 仅对应 lawan，未包含 -lah；此处按原包保留。缺失的音节字段保留 null。

senses.zh_definition: 抵抗吧；反抗吧；奋力克服吧。用于劝勉或命令对方抵抗某人、某种压力或困难。
senses.en_definition: Resist, oppose, or fight against someone or something, as an exhortation or command.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk suruhan atau dorongan supaya menentang, melawan atau mengatasi seseorang atau sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 这是 lawan 在祈使结构中附加 -lah 的用法；马来文释义为构式说明，并非输入词典的逐字引文。不可把词根 lawan 的“对手、搭档”等名词义直接移植到此处。-lah 可加强劝勉，也可随语调表达挑战，并不自动使命令客气。小品词分类参见 [DBP：Perihal Penonjolan Maklumat](https://dewanbahasa.jendeladbp.my/2023/03/13/7523/)。

senses.zh_definition: 迎战吧；与对手较量吧。用于鼓励或要求对方参加竞争。

etymology.historical_story: Lawan brings together two familiar social situations: facing an adversary and meeting a sporting opponent. Adding -lah turns the verbal use into an appeal whose force depends on the speaker's voice and relationship with the listener. A coach can make it encouraging; an angry speaker can make it confrontational. The particle contributes interactional force rather than a new lexical root.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lawan＝对抗；加 -lah，像在场边喊：“上吧，迎战吧！”

etymology.historical_story: English lung descends through Middle English lunge from Old English lungen. Its Germanic relatives include words associated with lightness in weight, an unexpected connection for the name of an internal organ. This inherited English history is separate from Malay terminology: DBP supplies paru-paru and peparu as Malay equivalents. See [Merriam-Webster](https://www.merriam-webster.com/dictionary/lung) and [DBP PRPM](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=lung).

etymology.historical_story: In 1682, René-Robert Cavelier de La Salle named the territory Louisiana in honour of France's King Louis XIV. The colonial name originally covered a vast region associated with the Mississippi basin, not merely today's state. Remembering that wider geography helps distinguish historical Louisiana from modern Louisiana on a map. [National Park Service](https://www.nps.gov/jela/learn/historyculture/early-europeans-in-louisiana.htm)

etymology.historical_story: The base luka connects bodily injury with emotional pain in Malay. DBP records both wounded skin and a wounded heart, alongside a proverb in which a wound disappears but its scar remains. Lukakan adds a causative relationship to that semantic core: someone causes the hurt. This explains its emotional imagery without requiring an unsupported claim about a distant borrowing source. [DBP luka](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=luka)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: luka 是“伤”，-kan 把伤带给对象：lukakan hati，就是“把心伤了”。

etymology.historical_story: The likely intended form, inilah, combines the Malay demonstrative ini, meaning “this,” with the attached emphatic particle -lah. Its structure illustrates how Malay highlights a referent without adding a separate word equivalent to English “exactly.” The supplied spelling lnilah probably reflects confusion between lowercase l and uppercase I in transcription or OCR; that explanation remains an inference, not a separate word origin.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先认字母：ini 的开头是 i，不是 l。再记 ini（这）＋lah（强调）＝inilah（这就是）。

senses.zh_definition: 兰登：英语专名，可作姓氏；例如小说人物 Robert Langdon 的姓。现有材料不足以确认小写 langdon 是马来语普通词。
senses.en_definition: Langdon, an English proper name used as a surname, including that of the fictional character Robert Langdon; no Malay common-word meaning is established here.
senses.ms_definition: Langdon ialah nama khas bahasa Inggeris yang digunakan sebagai nama keluarga, misalnya dalam nama Robert Langdon; makna sebagai kata umum bahasa Melayu belum dapat disahkan.
senses.nuances: 词性 noun 在此指 kata nama khas。专名身份可由 [Dan Brown 官方作品介绍](https://danbrown.com/books/novels/) 核实，但不能据此认定输入数据中的每个 langdon 都指该人物。以下为专名组合示例，并非已验证的高频普通词搭配；本条不虚设 DBP 官方释义。

etymology.historical_story: The English surname Langdon is associated with place names formed from Old English elements meaning long and hill. Such names originally identified people through their home locality. This surname history does not establish a Malay common noun or identify the source of this packet's lowercase token. [Dictionary of American Family Names, via FamilySearch](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=langdon).

senses.zh_definition: 【英语】陆地；土地；具有特定用途或归属的一片地面。
senses.en_definition: The solid surface of the earth, or an area of ground.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, daratan atau sesuatu kawasan tanah.
senses.nuances: 马来语通常按语境使用 daratan 或 tanah。以下搭配为英语搭配，马来文释义为释义译文，不是官方马来语词条定义。[Cambridge 英语词典](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/land)。

senses.zh_definition: 【英语】国家；国土；某种特色鲜明的地域。
senses.en_definition: A country or a region regarded as a particular place.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, negeri, negara atau wilayah tertentu.
senses.nuances: 此义常见于文学、文化描述及 native land 等表达；不能一律直译为 tanah。以下为英语搭配。[Cambridge 英语词典](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/land)。

collocations.en: a country other than one's own

senses.zh_definition: 【英语】着陆、落地或登陆；使飞机着陆，或将人员、货物运送上岸。
senses.en_definition: To arrive on the ground or ashore, or cause someone or something to do so.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris, mendarat atau mend Junratkan orang, kenderaan atau barang.
senses.nuances: 可作不及物或及物动词。马来语应按句法使用 mendarat 或 mendaratkan。以下为英语搭配。[Cambridge 英语词典](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/land)。

collocations.en: bring an aircraft down to the ground

senses.zh_definition: 【英语口语】成功获得想要的工作、合同或其他机会。
senses.en_definition: To succeed in obtaining something desirable.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam bahasa Inggeris tidak formal, berjaya memperoleh sesuatu yang diingini, seperti pekerjaan atau kontrak.
senses.nuances: 这是英语口语义；标准马来语可使用 berjaya mendapat 或 berjaya memperoleh。以下为英语搭配。[Cambridge 英语词典](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/land)。

etymology.historical_story: English land continues Old English land, also written lond, and belongs to the Germanic vocabulary. Its modern meanings connect ground, territory and arrival on a surface. In Malay conversation, an English form may appear through code-switching; that occurrence alone does not establish an officially adopted Malay word. [Word history](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/land).

senses.zh_definition: 降落；着陆；也可指从船只上岸的过程。属于英语名词用法。
senses.en_definition: The act of coming down onto the ground or coming ashore.
senses.ms_definition: Perbuatan atau proses mendarat, khususnya bagi pesawat udara, atau turun ke darat dari kapal; padanan bahasa Melayunya ialah pendaratan.
senses.nuances: 常见于英语航空术语及双语说明；标准马来语通常用 pendaratan。不能因为英文形式出现在马来语语料中，就认定它是一般正式马来语词形。[DBP：航空航天术语](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/angkasa1.pdf)

senses.zh_definition: 降落；着陆；马来西亚英语夹杂口语中，可作为表示飞机降落的动词使用。
senses.en_definition: To land, especially of an aircraft, in informal Malay–English code-switching.
senses.ms_definition: Mendarat, khususnya bagi pesawat udara; digunakan sebagai kata kerja dalam percakapan yang mencampurkan bahasa Melayu dengan bahasa Inggeris.
senses.nuances: 在 dah landing、nak landing 等混合表达中，landing 可充当谓语；英语 -ing 在这种马来语句式里不必表示进行时。正式马来语用 sudah mendarat 或 akan mendarat。

senses.zh_definition: 躺下休息；以飞机着陆作比喻的马来西亚非正式口语说法。
senses.en_definition: To lie down or settle down for a rest, in informal Malaysian usage.
senses.ms_definition: Berbaring atau merebahkan badan untuk berehat; penggunaan kiasan dalam percakapan tidak rasmi.
senses.nuances: 通常由沙发、床、疲累等上下文确定，不表示真的乘飞机着陆，也不必然表示睡着。正式表达用 berbaring 或 berehat。[马来西亚媒体中的此用法](https://siraplimau.com/selepas-makan)

senses.zh_definition: 楼梯顶部、底部或两段楼梯之间的平台；也可指坡道之间的平坦休息平台。
senses.en_definition: A level platform at the top or bottom of stairs, between flights of stairs, or along a ramp.
senses.ms_definition: Ruang atau pelantar rata pada bahagian atas atau bawah tangga, antara dua susunan anak tangga, atau pada laluan landas angkat.
senses.nuances: 这是建筑语境的英语用法，马来语可依具体结构用 pelantar tangga 或 pelantar rata；不能译作飞机“降落”。[英语词典：landing](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/landing)，[PLANMalaysia：pelantar rata](https://mytownnet.planmalaysia.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2022/06/GPP-KAWASAN-LAPANG.pdf)

etymology.historical_story: English landing combines land with -ing and can name either an arrival on the ground or a platform beside stairs. In Malaysian mixed-language conversation, the whole form can function as a verb alongside Malay words such as dah. Informal usage also pictures a tired person settling onto a sofa as if making a landing. [English senses](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/landing), [Malaysian figurative usage](https://siraplimau.com/selepas-makan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 land“落到地面”：飞机 landing 是着陆，人往沙发上一 landing 是躺下；楼梯的 landing 则是让脚步停稳的平台。

morphology.formula: ∅ + Leonid → Leonid（作为完整专名记忆）
morphology.pattern_note: 在马来语中作为完整名称使用，无马来语词缀变化。人名与天文学名称的来源须分别理解；不能把历史来源当作现代马来语构词规则。

senses.zh_definition: 列昂尼德：用于俄语、乌克兰语等语言的男性名字，马来语文本中通常保留拼写 Leonid。
senses.en_definition: A masculine given name used in Russian, Ukrainian, and other languages.
senses.ms_definition: Nama peribadi lelaki yang digunakan antaranya dalam bahasa Rusia dan bahasa Ukraine.
senses.nuances: 属于专有名词，通常写作 Leonid。人名性质及语言分布见[Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/leonid)。不同语言及本人习惯可能采用不同读音，本条未指定统一马来语 IPA。输入包的音节和爪夷文字段保留为 null；排名未经独立验证。未核实 DBP 官方独立词条，释义为编写释义。以下人名短语为教学示例，未经搭配频率验证。

senses.zh_definition: 狮子座流星雨的名称，常见于马来语短语 hujan meteor Leonid 或 juraian meteor Leonid。
senses.en_definition: The name of the Leonid meteor shower, whose apparent radiant lies in the constellation Leo.
senses.ms_definition: Nama hujan meteor yang titik pancaran ketara meteornya terletak di buruj Leo.
senses.nuances: 天文学名称，须根据上下文与人名区分。马来西亚官方出版物使用 juraian meteor Leonid，并采用 hujan meteor 这一类别名称，见[雪兰莪州宗教司署《Risalah Falak 2025》](https://www.muftiselangor.gov.my/wp-content/uploads/2025/10/Risalah-Falak-2025-Edisi-15.pdf)。辐射点位于狮子座的说明见[ESA](https://www.esa.int/Science_Exploration/Space_Science/About_the_Leonids)。这里的“来自狮子座”指视觉上的辐射方向，不表示流星物质源自狮子座恒星。马来语释义为编写释义。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 人物介绍与天文报道都可出现 Leonid。初次向普通读者介绍流星雨时，使用完整短语 hujan meteor Leonid，便于理解；涉及人物时补充姓氏或身份以避免混淆。情景句和聊天内容均为教学例句。

etymology.historical_story: As a personal name, Leonid is a Russian and Ukrainian form of the Greek name Leonidas. [Behind the Name](https://www.behindthename.com/name/leonid). Astronomy gives the spelling a separate naming history: the Leonids take their name from Leo, the constellation containing their apparent radiant, while their particles come from comet Tempel–Tuttle. The shower is not named after a person called Leonid. [ESA](https://www.esa.int/Science_Exploration/Space_Science/About_the_Leonids).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 看到 Leonid 先看搭配：有人物姓名时记“列昂尼德”；前面出现 meteor 时，联想 Leo 狮子座，记“狮子座流星雨”。

morphology.pattern_note: 单音节外来词，按数据包读作 lingk，词尾为 /ŋk/。计量义没有常用的规范马来语派生词；数字语境中的 pautan 是对应词，不是 link 的形态派生词。

senses.zh_definition: 令；传统测量长度单位，等于一链的百分之一，约为0.2米。
senses.en_definition: A traditional surveying unit of length equal to one hundredth of a chain, approximately 0.2 metres.
senses.ms_definition: Ukuran panjang yang bersamaan dengan satu per seratus rantai atau 0.2 meter.
senses.nuances: 这是数据包所载《Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat》的正式义项，主要用于传统测量及旧记录；0.2米是约数。按国际英尺定义的测量链，1 link 为0.201168米，历史资料的具体换算还须核对所用单位标准。搭配属于专业用语，日常频率较低。[NIST：单位换算表](https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/Legacy/hb/nisthandbook44-1995.pdf)。

senses.zh_definition: 链接；非正式马来语交流中夹用的英语词，指通往网页、文件或其他数字资源的链接。
senses.en_definition: In informal Malay, an English code-switch meaning a hyperlink to a digital resource.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam percakapan tidak rasmi, pautan yang membawa pengguna ke halaman web, fail atau sumber digital lain.
senses.nuances: 此义是另行标注的非正式英语夹用，不是数据包所载的计量义，也不因本词条 status 为 official 而成为该词典的正式数字义项。标准马来语通常用 pautan；本义马来文释义是用法说明。[DBP：pautan](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=pautan)。

etymology.historical_story: The measurement sense belongs to the English surveying vocabulary of chains and links. A surveyor's chain contains one hundred links, making the small unit part of a larger measuring system. The packet preserves this specialist meaning. Its English form suggests borrowing, although the packet supplies no borrowing date. Informal digital usage represents a separate use of English link. [NIST](https://nvlpubs.nist.gov/nistpubs/Legacy/hb/nisthandbook44-1995.pdf)。

etymology.historical_story: Longgokan belongs to the Malay family built on longgok, meaning a heap. The suffix -an names the gathered material, while berlonggok describes things lying together and melonggokkan describes putting them into a heap. [DBP records this family](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=371752&keyword=longgok), connecting the vocabulary of piled fruit, household clothing, and accumulated rubbish without requiring a speculative origin story.

morphology.pattern_note: -kah 是疑问附着小品词，不是产生新词义的派生后缀；与前词连写，lagi 不变音。输入 Jawi لاݢي 仅对应词根。正式疑问句通常须调整整句结构，不能只机械添加 -kah。

senses.zh_definition: 还……吗；询问某种状态是否仍然持续，或预期的变化是否尚未发生。
senses.en_definition: Still? Yet? Used to question whether a state continues or an expected change has occurred.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk lagi dengan partikel tanya -kah untuk menanyakan sama ada sesuatu keadaan masih berterusan atau perubahan yang dijangka belum berlaku.
senses.nuances: 意思由整句决定；例如 Belum siap lagikah? 表示“还没完成吗？”。句末 -kah 常见于口语，正式书面语通常改为 Adakah ... 或其他合适结构。参见 [DBP：lagi](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=150348&keyword=lagi)、[DBP：疑问小品词的位置](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sudah+kah)。

senses.zh_definition: 还有吗；还要更多吗；询问是否存在或需要额外的数量、时间或项目。
senses.en_definition: Any more? More? Used to ask about an additional quantity, amount, or item.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk pertanyaan yang menanyakan kewujudan atau keperluan tambahan kepada sesuatu yang sudah ada.
senses.nuances: Ada lagikah? 通常询问“还有吗”，而 Nak lagikah? 询问“还要吗”。这里并不一定表示同一动作重新发生。以下搭配示范口语疑问结构。

senses.zh_definition: 又……吗；再……吗；询问某个动作是否重复或将再次发生。
senses.en_definition: Again? Used to question the repetition or recurrence of an action or event.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk pertanyaan untuk menanyakan sama ada sesuatu perbuatan atau kejadian berulang.
senses.nuances: 可以是普通确认，也可因语调表达惊讶、厌烦或不耐烦。不要把 lagi 的所有词典义项直接当成 lagikah 的独立词义。

etymology.historical_story: Lagikah is a grammatical combination rather than a separate historical root. Lagi supplies continuation, addition, or repetition, while -kah marks a question. DBP distinguishes conversational questions with a final -kah from formal patterns that place the questioned element earlier. This explains why a natural spoken lagikah may have a differently arranged written equivalent. See [DBP's grammar advice](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=sudah+kah).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lagi 是“还／再”，-kah 像贴在后面的问号：lagi + ? → lagikah。

etymology.historical_story: DBP separates les into three homonyms: a lesson, a list, and a frame, all labelled as Indonesian Dutch borrowings. The lesson sense is additionally marked colloquial. This compact entry reflects regional vocabulary differences: a word familiar in Indonesian conversation may require a different everyday equivalent in Malaysia. Identical spelling does not establish one shared history for all three meanings. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=les)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: “课程”义可联想英语 lesson 的开头 les；这只是记忆联想。再单独记住另外两个同形义：名单、框架。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆；ng 表示 /ŋ/。部分马来西亚口音会降低末音节元音，出现接近输入音标 [laŋ.se(r)] 的读法。

etymology.historical_story: A curtain belongs to everyday domestic life, but its name should not acquire an invented borrowing story. DBP records langsir as the fabric covering a window or doorway and lists separate homonyms with unrelated meanings. The immediate historical source of this household word is not established by the supplied evidence. Treat it as a complete lexical stem. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=langsir)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lang.sir 分成两拍，想象两幅布帘向中间合拢；整词对应“窗帘”，无需拆出词缀。

etymology.historical_story: Libya preserves an ancient North African name associated with the Libu, a people recorded by the Egyptians. Greek usage extended the name to a much broader African region. Its modern national application reflects a later narrowing of that geographical label. Malay uses the international country name as an indivisible proper noun. [Name history](https://places.behindthename.com/name/libya)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Libya 的声音与中文“利比亚”直接配对，再联想北非地中海沿岸的地图位置；它是国家名，不必拆词缀。

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 在此是后附的第三人称代词，表示所属，并非派生新词的普通后缀；suffix 是本结构中的位置分类。词根末尾 h 保留，ny 读 /ɲ/，完整形式分音节为 li.dah.nya。输入 Jawi ليده 仅对应词根 lidah；完整形式为 ليدهڽ。

word_family.gloss: 有舌头；具有某种说话方式

senses.zh_definition: 他或她的舌头，即口腔中用于味觉、发音和舔舐等活动的可活动器官。
senses.en_definition: His or her tongue, the movable organ in the mouth used for tasting, speaking, and licking.
senses.ms_definition: Lidah seseorang yang dirujuk, iaitu organ di dalam mulut yang boleh digerakkan untuk merasa, bertutur dan menjilat.
senses.nuances: -nya 不区分男性与女性，所指对象由上下文确定。lidahnya 是名词加所属代词的组合，不能一概译成不带所属关系的“舌头”。后附代词与前词连写，见[DBP 拼写规范](https://eseminar.dbp.gov.my/dokumen/ejaan.pdf)。

collocations.en: stick out his or her tongue

collocations.zh: 不小心咬到自己的舌头
collocations.en: accidentally bite his or her own tongue

senses.zh_definition: 他或她的言辞、说话方式或发音表现；由“舌头”引申而来。
senses.en_definition: His or her speech, manner of speaking, or articulation.
senses.ms_definition: Tutur kata atau cara seseorang yang dirujuk melafazkan perkataan, digunakan secara kiasan.
senses.nuances: 具体含义由搭配决定：fasih lidahnya 侧重说话流利；manis lidahnya 可指言语悦耳，也可能暗示善于讨好；lidahnya bercabang 则指言语不可信。不要把所有涉及 lidah 的惯用语都解释为身体器官。

collocations.zh: 他或她说话反复、不可信

senses.zh_definition: 所指物体上形似舌头的部件，如鞋舌或乐器的簧舌；须由上下文明确物体。
senses.en_definition: The tongue-shaped part of the object referred to, such as a shoe tongue or an instrument reed.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian pada sesuatu benda yang dirujuk yang bentuknya menyerupai lidah, seperti lidah kasut atau lidah serunai.
senses.nuances: 这是词根 lidah 的比喻义在带 -nya 形式中的运用，通常先交代所属物体。作为学习搭配，宜先掌握完整名称 lidah kasut、lidah serunai，再理解上下文中的 lidahnya。

collocations.zh: 唢呐类吹管乐器的簧舌

senses.zh_definition: 所指事物向外伸出的舌状部分，如火焰尖端或伸入水中的地段。
senses.en_definition: The projecting, tongue-like portion of the thing referred to, such as a flame tip or a tongue of land.
senses.ms_definition: Bahagian sesuatu yang dirujuk yang menganjur keluar, seperti hujung nyala api atau tanah yang menjorok ke dalam air.
senses.nuances: 常见于描写性文字和固定组合。lidah api 与 lidah tanah 是词根层面的搭配；实际使用 lidahnya 时须有明确的前文指称。词根相关义项见[DBP：lidah](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=lidah)。

etymology.historical_story: Lidah belongs to an old Austronesian vocabulary connecting the tongue with licking; comparative research groups related forms under reconstructed *dilaq. Malay also extends this bodily image to speech and projecting shapes. Lidahnya adds the ordinary third-person possessive clitic, so its history combines inherited vocabulary with a productive grammatical construction. [Comparative evidence](https://acd.clld.org/cognatesets/30254)

senses.zh_definition: 英语动词 laugh 的一般现在时第三人称单数形式：笑、发笑；与 at 等成分连用时，也可表示嘲笑或轻蔑地对待。
senses.en_definition: Third-person singular present of laugh: to express amusement through vocal sounds, or, in context, to mock or treat something with scorn.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk kata kerja bahasa Inggeris bagi orang ketiga tunggal dalam kala kini, yang bermaksud ketawa; mengikut konteks, boleh juga bermaksud mentertawakan atau memperlekehkan.
senses.nuances: 不是标准马来语词。马来语通常用 ketawa；表示嘲笑具体对象时可用 mentertawakan。转录中的 [laughs] 通常记录说话者发笑这一动作，不表示说话者真的说出了 laughs。马来文释义为编写的跨语言释义，并非 DBP 引文。英语义项及基本读音依据：[Cambridge：laugh](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/laugh?q=laugh)。以下搭配保留英语目标形式，并在 ms 字段附马来语对应表达。

laughs at a joke → ketawa mendengar jenaka

senses.ms_definition: Keseronokan atau kelucuan dalam penggunaan tidak formal bahasa Inggeris, khususnya dalam ungkapan yang bermaksud sekadar untuk berseronok atau bergurau.
senses.nuances: for laughs 侧重“为了好玩、逗乐”，不宜逐字译成“为了多声笑声”。这种用法属于英语表达，不能据此认为 laughs 已成为马来语普通名词。义项依据：[Cambridge：laugh](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/laugh?q=laugh)。

etymology.historical_story: English laugh descends from Old English forms such as hliehhan. Its spelling preserves traces of an earlier pronunciation: the consonant represented by gh eventually became /f/ in this word. Modern laughs adds an ordinary English -s ending. Finding it in Malay material therefore signals an English form requiring contextual interpretation, rather than Malay affixation. Reference: [Etymonline: laugh](https://www.etymonline.com/word/laugh).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: laugh 先读成 /lɑːf/ 或 /læf/，再接 /s/：laughs 仍只有一个音节；马来语“笑”记 ketawa。

etymology.historical_story: Oxford lists Lizzy as an alternative spelling of Lizzie, a familiar form of Elizabeth. This establishes an English personal-name interpretation, rather than a Malay common-word meaning. A name can appear naturally inside a Malay sentence without becoming a Malay dictionary headword. The supplied lowercase token alone does not identify any particular person. [Oxford name entry](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/definition/english/lizzie)

morphology.formula: ∅ + lai → lai；表示薄片时：helai → lai（截短）
morphology.pattern_note: lai 为单音节，ai 构成双元音 /aj/。薄片义来自 helai 的截短；梨义是另一个同形词，不能用 helai 解释。

word_family.gloss: 薄片；用于纸、叶、衣物等的量词；与截短义 lai 对应
一张、一片、一件；由完整形式 helai 构成

senses.zh_definition: helai 的截短形式：薄片、叶片；也可承担 helai 的量词功能。
senses.en_definition: A shortened form of helai: a sheet or leaf, also used as a classifier.
senses.ms_definition: Kependekan bagi helai.
senses.nuances: 数据包对应此义，不能直接替换成“梨”。正式计数通常使用完整形式 helai，如 dua helai kertas；lai 的截短形式不宜作为所有场合的默认量词。参见 [DBP：helai 与 lai](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=helai)。

collocations.zh: 两张纸；使用完整形式 helai

senses.ms_definition: Buah pir Cina; lazim disebut buah lai.
senses.nuances: 这是与 helai 截短义不同的同形词。DBP《Kamus Inggeris-Melayu Dewan》将 Chinese pear 译为“(buah) lai”；不能据此把所有品种的 pear 都限定为 lai。参见 [DBP：Chinese pear](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=72508&keyword=pear)。

etymology.historical_story: Two dictionary trails meet in this spelling. One lai is explicitly recorded as a shortening of helai, the familiar Malay word for a sheet or classifier. Another appears in buah lai, translated by DBP as Chinese pear. These meanings should remain separate: identical spelling does not establish a shared origin, and the supplied packet documents only the first.

morphology.pattern_note: -nya 是附着成分，可表示第三人称所属，也可使事件表达名词化；在 pada lahirnya 中形成惯用状语。ny 读单一腭鼻音 /ɲ/。保留输入爪夷文 لاهير；它对应 lahir，完整 lahirnya 写作 لاهيرڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 他、她或它的出生；某个婴儿或幼体降生这一事件。
senses.en_definition: His, her, or its birth; the event of a child or young animal being born.
senses.ms_definition: Peristiwa seseorang atau sesuatu anak haiwan keluar daripada kandungan; kelahirannya.
senses.nuances: 这是 lahir 加 -nya 后在名词性环境中的用法，并非另一个独立词根。sejak lahirnya 可表示“自他／她出生以来”；lahirnya bayi itu 则表示“那个婴儿的降生”。[DBP：lahir 与 kelahiran](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=lahir)

collocations.en: the moment of a baby's birth

senses.zh_definition: 某事物的产生、出现或创立；思想、作品、制度等的诞生。
senses.en_definition: The emergence, creation, or coming into existence of something.
senses.ms_definition: Peristiwa muncul, terhasil atau wujudnya sesuatu, seperti idea, karya atau pertubuhan.
senses.nuances: 常见于书面语。lahirnya 后可直接接说明主体的名词短语，如 lahirnya sebuah negara。此处的 -nya 不必译成“他的”，整个结构可译为“……的诞生”。[DBP：lahir](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=lahir)

collocations.en: the emergence of a new idea

senses.zh_definition: 从外表看；就表面所显现的情况而言，通常用于 pada lahirnya。
senses.en_definition: Outwardly; judging by appearances, especially in pada lahirnya.
senses.ms_definition: Pada pandangan luaran atau berdasarkan keadaan yang kelihatan sahaja.
senses.nuances: 词性标注针对整个惯用表达 pada lahirnya 的状语功能；单独的 lahirnya 并非在所有句子中都是副词。这一义项常与 batin 或实际情况形成对照，也涵盖“外在、形体方面”的理解。[DBP：lahir 的外在义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=73980&keyword=lahir)

collocations.en: viewed in terms of its outward aspect

etymology.historical_story: Lahir belongs to a history of Arabic words adapted into Malay; linguistic research connects it with zahir, from Arabic ẓāhir, meaning outward or apparent. Modern Malay lahir covers both outward appearance and birth. Adding -nya creates contextual meanings such as someone's birth or the emergence of an idea; the ending itself is Malay grammar, not part of the Arabic source. [Linguistic study](https://plm.org.my/ejurnal/index.php/jurnallinguistik/article/download/127/112/)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 la-hir 想成“来到眼前”：宝宝来到世上是出生，想法来到眼前是产生；加 -nya 后结合上下文理解“其出生／……的诞生”。

morphology.pattern_note: 双音节词根，无附加词缀。派生词 melalikan 中 meN- 在 l 前表现为 me-，词根首音 l 保留；鱼名义属于同形词。

sociolinguistic_register.usage_etiquette: 谈论他人的痛苦时，应避免用这个词轻率断定对方已经不难受。鱼类或脚踝语境须结合 ikan lali、buku lali 等完整表达理解。

etymology.historical_story: Lali offers a useful semantic bridge between body and experience: skin may lose sensation, while repeated hardship or noise may lose its emotional impact. DBP records both meanings and separately lists a freshwater fish with the same spelling. This semantic relationship is clear; it does not establish the word's deeper historical origin. [Source](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=lali).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 la-li 想成噪声不断重复的“啦哩、啦哩”：听久了没反应，就是 lali“习惯到麻木”。鱼名另记；拟声仅作记忆。

etymology.historical_story: Larkin is encountered in Malaysian Malay as a place name, especially through the bus terminal in Johor Bahru. Travellers associate it with departures, arrivals and journeys across the peninsula. The terminal documents this local identity, but does not establish the original naming history. A specific colonial namesake should therefore not be presented as settled fact. [Terminal website](https://www.larkinsentraljb.com.my/)

etymology.historical_story: Lirik brings several dictionary histories under one spelling. Its literary meanings connect poetry with sung words, while another entry concerns a sideways glance. A further cross-reference leads to larik and the shaping of materials. These separate entries explain why a song, a look and a workshop must not share one invented origin story.

senses.zh_definition: 活动强度大、动作较粗放或对体能要求高的，常用于户外活动和运动。
senses.en_definition: Physically demanding or involving vigorous, rough activity.
senses.ms_definition: Melibatkan kegiatan fizikal yang kasar, mencabar atau memerlukan ketahanan.
senses.nuances: sukan lasak 是通行术语，范围包含攀登、激流活动和越野运动等；不一定每项都属于专业意义上的“极限运动”。[DBP 用语解答](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=lasak)

etymology.historical_story: Lasak is an independent Malay base with several established dictionary senses. Everyday clothing, restless children and demanding outdoor activities all appear in its usage. The familiar expression tahan lasak adds endurance: something withstands repeated use or someone handles hard work. These associations provide a cultural memory map without establishing a single historical origin for every sense.
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 la.sak 配成两拍动作：跑一步、跳一下；想到停不下来的孩子，就是 lasak。再加 tahan（经得住），tahan lasak 就是耐折腾。

morphology.formula: ∅ + looking → looking（作为英语整词记录）；英语内部：look + -ing → looking
morphology.pattern_note: 沿用数据包的根词字段，仅表示本记录未进行马来语派生分析；looking 实际是英语 look 的 -ing 形式。英语 -ing 通常读 /ɪŋ/，并非马来语词缀。[Cambridge：读音](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/us/dictionary/english/looking)

word_family.gloss: 英语过去式及过去分词

senses.zh_definition: 英语 look 的 -ing 形式：把目光投向某处以观看或查看；马来语可按语境译为 melihat、memandang 或 meneliti。
senses.en_definition: The -ing form of look: directing one's eyes toward something to see or examine it.
senses.ms_definition: Bentuk -ing bagi kata kerja bahasa Inggeris look yang merujuk perbuatan melihat, memandang atau meneliti sesuatu.
senses.nuances: 这是英语形式的马来语说明，不是官方马来语词义。looking at 后接观看对象；looking 本身不一定表示现在进行时，也可用于非限定结构。下列 ms 字段保留英语搭配以展示原词用法。[Cambridge：look 的语法](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/look)

senses.zh_definition: 在英语 looking for 结构中表示寻找、寻求；马来语对应 mencari。
senses.en_definition: In looking for, trying to find a person or thing.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam ungkapan bahasa Inggeris looking for, berusaha menemukan seseorang atau sesuatu; padanannya ialah mencari.
senses.nuances: 寻找义来自 looking for 这一结构，不应把 for 任意省略。标准马来语使用 mencari，进行中的动作可用 sedang mencari。[Cambridge：look for](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/dictionary/english/look-for)

senses.zh_definition: 在英语系动词结构中表示看起来呈现某种状态；马来语通常对应 kelihatan 或 nampak。
senses.en_definition: Appearing or seeming to have a particular quality or condition.
senses.ms_definition: Kelihatan berada dalam keadaan tertentu, sebagaimana dinyatakan oleh pelengkap selepas kata kerja tersebut.
senses.nuances: 如 looking tired 表示显得疲倦。good-looking 等复合形容词属于另一种结构，不能据此把所有 looking 都标为形容词。[Cambridge：look 的系动词用法](https://dictionary.cambridge.org/grammar/british-grammar/look)

collocations.zh: 看起来不错；情况显得良好

etymology.historical_story: Looking belongs to English grammar: it combines look with the ending -ing. In a multilingual conversation, speakers may insert an English expression into an otherwise Malay sentence without turning it into a standard Malay word. Its interpretation therefore depends on the surrounding construction: looking at, looking for, and looking tired express different relationships.

etymology.historical_story: Lakhs belongs to English usage associated with South Asian counting. Its singular lakh entered English through Hindi and ultimately derives from Sanskrit. English adds the plural ending -s, producing lakhs. This history explains why a Malay-language discussion may quote the expression without making it a standard Malay headword or assigning it an invented Jawi spelling. [Collins: lakh](https://www.collinsdictionary.com/dictionary/english/lakh).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 1 lakh = 100,000 = 十万；再记英语 -s 表复数，lakhs 就是若干个“十万”。别与数词 laksa（一万）混淆。

etymology.historical_story: Lahore is an inherited South Asian place name rather than a Malay compound. The city’s official historical account connects its beginnings with Loh, a son of Rama, but this should be presented as a traditional origin story rather than settled linguistic evidence. Its Mughal past also helps explain its strong cultural associations. [Source: Lahore district administration](https://lahore.punjab.gov.pk/our_history).

etymology.historical_story: Lubuk belongs to the Malay vocabulary of waterways: its concrete meaning is a deep part of a river or another body of water. Malay also uses that image for inner feeling and difficult circumstances. Expressions involving the heart turn physical depth into emotional depth, while traditional proverbs connect changing pools and shores with changing fortunes. [DBP dictionary entry](https://prpmv1.dbp.gov.my/Search.aspx?k=lubuk.)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 lu-buk 两拍想成石头落水再沉底：表面是河，底下更深的一窝就是 lubuk；lubuk hati 就是心底最深的一窝。此为意象记忆，并非历史词源。

etymology.historical_story: Malay expressions turn saliva into an image of appetite, speech, and reputation. Air liur names the bodily fluid, while menjilat air liur describes praising something previously condemned. This figurative connection makes spoken words seem physically retractable. It offers a cultural route into remembering liur without inventing an undocumented account of its distant origin. See [DBP: liur](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=82736&keyword=liur).

etymology.historical_story: Historical Indonesian dictionary records preserve lila as a name for a small copper or bronze cannon, while Malaysian dictionary material records related artillery under lela. These records place the word in the vocabulary of regional weapons and heritage. They establish a historical meaning, but do not establish a secure ultimate etymology. [Dictionary record](https://kbbi.web.id/lila), [DBP: lela](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=202792&keyword=Lela).

etymology.historical_story: Laila belongs to the Arabic name tradition associated with layl, meaning night. The heroine of the Layla and Majnun romance carried the name across literary traditions, including Malay retellings. In Malaysian usage, it functions as a person's name, rather than an ordinary substitute for malam, the everyday Malay word for night. [Name background](https://journals.aiac.org.au/index.php/IJCLTS/article/viewFile/2022/1819), [Malay literary records](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=10456&keyword=laila).

etymology.historical_story: The international term logo is a shortened form of logogram or logotype, words connected with Greek logos, meaning word or speech. Its history links written language with visual identification: lettering and symbols become a recognizable identity. In Malay, logo functions as a complete borrowed word rather than a native affix construction. [American Heritage Dictionary](https://www.ahdictionary.com/word/search.html?q=logo).

etymology.historical_story: English lone developed in Middle English as a shortened form of alone. Its history belongs to English, and its appearance in a Malay vocabulary list does not establish Malay borrowing. For learners, the useful distinction is between being without companions and being the only person or thing in a particular situation. [Oxford word origin](https://www.oxfordlearnersdictionaries.com/us/definition/english/lone).

senses.ms_definition: Nama khas dewi bulan dalam mitologi Rom. Bentuk luna sebagai kata nama am tidak mempunyai takrif bahasa Melayu DBP yang dapat disahkan.

etymology.historical_story: DBP's encyclopedic material mentions Luna as the Roman counterpart of the Greek moon goddess Selene. This provides a documented proper-name use within Malay reference writing. It does not establish lowercase luna as an ordinary Malay word for the moon; DBP's language advice explicitly distinguishes the unrecorded form from lunar. [DBP: Luna and Selene](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=kepulangan), [DBP: language advice](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=kalendar%3B).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 Luna 记成“露娜女神”的名字；日常说月亮用 bulan，说“与月亮有关的”可用 lunar。

morphology.pattern_note: 按人名整词记忆，不拆分马来语词缀。原包未提供音节、读音或爪夷文；人名读音须依本人使用习惯确认。

senses.en_definition: Leila, a feminine personal name; not established here as a Malay common noun.
senses.ms_definition: Nama khas perempuan, lazimnya ditulis Leila dengan huruf awal besar; bukan takrif kata umum yang disahkan oleh paket DBP.
senses.nuances: 原包没有 DBP 释义，故专名解释属于有依据的暂定识别，不能确定原始语料中的具体指称。status 按指定格式保留为 official，并不表示该普通词条已获 DBP 认证。以下为自然称呼组合，不是已验证的高频固定搭配。参见 [Leila 人名资料](https://www.behindthename.com/name/leila)。

etymology.historical_story: Leila belongs to an international family of feminine names associated with Layla. Its spelling occurs across several languages, so pronunciation cannot safely be inferred from a lower-case corpus token alone. In this entry, the personal-name interpretation is provisional; it does not establish a separate Malay common-word meaning. See [name history](https://www.behindthename.com/name/leila).

morphology.pattern_note: 原形无词缀。meN- 接 l 时采用 me-，保留 l：meN- + lapis → melapis。标准读音为 [la.pis]；资料包中的 [la.pes] 反映部分马来西亚口音中闭音节 /i/ 的降低。

word_family.gloss: 将某物铺成覆盖层；叠放

senses.zh_definition: 层；相互叠置或相邻排列的结构中的一层，也用于表示材料的层数。
senses.en_definition: A layer or stratum within a superimposed or adjoining arrangement.
senses.ms_definition: Susunan yang bertingkat-tingkat atau bertindih-tindih, dengan satu di atas atau di sebelah yang lain.
senses.nuances: 常见于 dua lapis、tiga lapis 等数量结构。lapis 侧重可数的层，lapisan 更常用于命名某个层体或社会阶层。名词不直接等于英语动词 layer；正式表达铺层动作通常用 melapis 或 melapiskan。[DBP：lapis](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=lapis)

senses.zh_definition: 排；列；人或物按若干横排或行列形成的排列单位。
senses.en_definition: A row or rank of people or objects.
senses.ms_definition: Deretan atau barisan yang tersusun dalam saf.
senses.nuances: 这是空间排列义，不一定上下堆叠；多见于描写队伍、围观人群或防御阵列。日常直接说“一排人”通常用 sebaris orang。[DBP：lapis](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=lapis)

senses.zh_definition: 覆层；衬层；附着在另一物体上的薄片或薄层材料。
senses.en_definition: A thin covering or lining attached to another object.
senses.ms_definition: Bahan atau kepingan nipis yang dilekatkan pada benda lain sebagai penutup atau pelapik.
senses.nuances: 强调所附着的材料。lapis emas 表示金质覆层；描述镀金饰品时，常用 berlapis emas。服装语境中可与 lapik 的部分用法重叠。[DBP：lapis](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=lapis)

senses.zh_definition: 切成薄片或撕成细条的，多指肉类；属于少见义。
senses.en_definition: Thinly sliced or finely shredded, especially of meat.
senses.ms_definition: Dalam keadaan telah disayat atau dicarik menjadi bahagian yang halus, seperti daging.
senses.nuances: 《Kamus Dewan》另列为 lapis II 的一个义项。现代日常食谱更常明确说 dihiris nipis 或 dicarik halus；本义缺少可靠的高频固定搭配，以下为释义性组合。[DBP：lapis II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=lapis)

collocations.en: thinly sliced or finely shredded meat

senses.zh_definition: 千层糕；由米粉或面粉与椰浆等制成、逐层蒸熟的糕点，通常以 kuih lapis 的形式出现。
senses.en_definition: A layered steamed cake made with rice or wheat flour and coconut milk.
senses.ms_definition: Sejenis kuih daripada tepung beras atau tepung gandum bersama santan, yang dikukus secara berlapis.
senses.nuances: 这是糕点名称义。kuih lapis 与 kek lapis 不宜一概混译：前者通常指蒸糕，后者通常指层叠蛋糕。DBP 此处亦列 lapis legit；实际食物名称及制作方式存在地域差异。[DBP：lapis II](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=274052&keyword=lapis)

collocations.en: a name for a layered cake

etymology.historical_story: Lapis belongs to an old Austronesian vocabulary of surfaces and layers. The Austronesian Comparative Dictionary reconstructs Proto-Malayo-Polynesian *lapis with meanings involving stone slabs and thin layers, and records related forms across several languages. Malay preserves the layering idea in everyday material descriptions. For learners, stacked fabric, paint coats and layered cakes provide concrete images of this inherited meaning. [Austronesian Comparative Dictionary](https://ling.lll.hawaii.edu/dicts/ACD/acd-s_l.htm)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 la-pis 联想成“拉一片，叠一片”：一片叠一片，就是一层又一层。此为记忆联想，不是词源拆解。

morphology.pattern_note: 整词记忆，不能拆成 lo- 和 -ji；字母 j 表示 /dʒ/。以下词族项目是复合词，不是加词缀形成的派生词。

senses.ms_definition: Kilang atau kemudahan pemprosesan yang merangkumi bangunan, jentera dan peralatannya.
senses.nuances: 现代最常见的义项，尤用于发电、水处理、污水处理和提炼设施。kilang 的适用范围更广；不能把所有商店、作坊或办公楼都称为 loji。释义据[DBP：loji](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=336480&keyword=loji)归纳。

senses.en_definition: A large building.

etymology.historical_story: Loji traces to Dutch loge, associated with a lodge or trading establishment. Historical Malay used it for trading-company premises, including Dutch posts. Its modern industrial meaning extends the association with a substantial operational site to facilities containing machinery and equipment. The older trading-post sense therefore survives beside familiar expressions such as loji air. See [DBP etymological study](https://dev.dbp.my/index.php/Melayu/ms/article/download/8757/4460/29941).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 loji 想成“整套机器住的大楼”：水进去处理，是 loji rawatan air；能源进去发电，是 loji kuasa。

morphology.pattern_note: 词根不变；ny 表示单一鼻音 /ɲ/。此处 -nya 可加强感叹或参与构成评注表达，不一定表示他的。输入 Jawi لوچو 是词根 lucu 的写法，完整 lucunya 写作 لوچوڽ。

senses.zh_definition: 真好笑；多么滑稽，用来感叹某人、某事或某种表现令人发笑。
senses.en_definition: How funny or amusing; expressing amusement at someone or something.
senses.ms_definition: Sangat menggelikan hati atau menyebabkan orang ketawa, dengan penegasan atau nada seruan.
senses.nuances: 如 Lucunya cerita itu!，强调好笑的程度。DBP 将词根 lucu 释为令人发笑、诙谐；完整词形的解释依据 lucu 与 -nya 的组合。不要一概译为可爱：马来西亚马来语表达可爱通常用 comel。参见 [DBP：lucu](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=lucu)。

senses.zh_definition: 有趣的是；说来也好笑，用作整句评注，引出令人觉得好笑或出乎意料的情况。

senses.ms_definition: Yang menggelikan hati atau menariknya, sebagai ulasan terhadap keadaan yang dinyatakan selepasnya.

etymology.historical_story: The useful story here is grammatical rather than a securely established ancient origin. DBP groups lucu with melucu, kelucuan and pelucu, showing a productive vocabulary of humor. Adding -nya lets speakers turn a simple description into an expressive reaction. Context then distinguishes an exclamation such as 'how funny' from a sentence-opening comment such as 'funnily enough.' [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/cari1?keyword=lucu)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 先记 lucu＝好笑，再把 -nya 当成此处的感叹放大器：Lucunya!＝真逗！

morphology.pattern_note: -an 构成表示接续或增加部分的名词；词根末尾 t 保留，并在音节划分中成为末音节 tan 的声母：lan.ju.tan。j 读 /dʒ/。

etymology.historical_story: Lanjutan is transparently formed from lanjut with the noun-forming suffix -an. Its dictionary meanings connect continued lessons or conversation with something added to what came before. The same idea appears in official correspondence, where lanjutan daripada links a new letter to an earlier discussion or document. These uses share a practical image of carrying something onward. [DBP usage guidance](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=Lanjutan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: lanjut 是“继续往下”，加 -an 就把“接下去的部分”变成名词：课程接下去是进修，期限接下去是延期。
